## 5 Large Example Prompts: Obsessively Optimized Hooks

These are production-ready Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） prompts. Each 15-25 lines, each obsessed with the first 2 seconds.

### Example 1: Satisfying Transformation Hook

```
Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）提示：

"Create a 30-second satisfying transformation video optimized for
TikTok with a hook that stops the infinite scroll.

HOOK STRUCTURE (First 2 seconds):
[0.0-0.3s] Open on extreme close-up (macro lens) of GRIMY, STAINED
SURFACE. Viewer cannot recognize what surface is. Lighting is harsh,
showing every crack, dirt particle, stain. Sound: ASMR scratching
sound (fingernail on dirt) with slight tension music underneath.

[0.3-0.8s] Zoom out slightly, but still magnified. Reveal surface is
a previously-white shoe (heavily stained, yellowed, disgusting). Pull
back further to show person holding the shoe. On-screen text appears
at 0.5s (large, bold, white sans-serif): 'THIS IS DISGUSTING'.
Sound: dramatic music sting, person groans with disgust.

[0.8-1.5s] Quick cut (0.1s transition) to person dipping shoe brush
into cleaning solution. Macro shot of bristles entering soapy water.
Bright blue-white soap. Sound: dipping sound, bristle swish.
On-screen text at 1.2s: 'WATCH WHAT HAPPENS'. Music builds slightly.

[1.5-2.0s] Cut to person scrubbing the shoe in fast-motion (2x speed).
Paint-like transformation: brown/yellow disappearing, white appearing.
Dramatic lighting catch on the brightening shoe. Sound: intense scrubbing
sound (ASMR satisfying), music crescendos. At 1.8s, reveal the shoe is
now BRILLIANTLY WHITE (before/after comparison visible). Cut to person's
shocked/delighted reaction (eyebrows up, slight smile). Viewer's brain
registers the transformation and MUST keep watching.

FULL VIDEO (Seconds 2-30):
[2-10s] Continue scrubbing process, show multiple angles, close-ups of
the whitening. Camera pulls back incrementally showing progress. Multiple
satisfying transformations of different stained spots.

[10-15s] Final rinse: water running over newly-white shoe, water turning
brown then clear. Slow-motion water droplets. Peak satisfaction moment.
Soft music resolution.

[15-25s] Before/side-by-side or before/after. Original dirty shoe visible
on one side, fresh white shoe on other. Person proudly holds clean shoe.

[25-30s] Final shot: person wearing the restored shoe, walking in clean
environment (beach, mall, park). Confidence visible. Ending text: 'SAVE THIS
FOR LATER' or 'COMMENT IF YOU NEED THIS'. Music resolves satisfyingly.

TECHNICAL SPECS:
- Format: 9:16 vertical (TikTok/Reels/Shorts optimized)
- Audio: Original ASMR cleaning sounds + music bed
- Music: Start at 0.3s, build through 2s, peak at 1.5s
- Text: Two text overlays in first 2 seconds (as described)
- Transitions: Cross-dissolve or quick cut (0.1s black frame)
- Pacing: Slow reveal 0-1s, accelerate 1-2s
- Color Grade: Warm tones for dirty shoe (satisfying contrast),
  cool/bright for clean shoe (transformation reward)
- Retention goal: 90%+ completion rate (satisfying transformation
  has high retention)

EDITING NOTES:
- Use macro/close-up lens for opening (iPhone macro mode or macro lens)
- Shoot in natural light or ring light (bright enough to see transformation)
- Multiple angles: close-up, medium (showing person), wide (showing
  before/after comparison)
- Use slow-motion for water/soapy shots (creates anticipation)
- Speed-up for scrubbing (shows progress, maintains energy)
- Color correction: desaturate/cool tones for 'before', boost saturation
  and warmth for 'after'

CAPTION SUGGESTION:
'POV: your shoes needed this. Tag someone who needs to see this cleaning
hack. #Satisfying #Cleaning #ASMR #BeforeAndAfter #TikTok'

HASHTAG STRATEGY:
- #Satisfying (trending category, high reach)
- #ASMR (targeting ASMR community, high engagement)
- #CleaningHacks (searchable, permanent traffic)
- #FYP #ForYouPage (algorithm signals)

AUDIO SUGGESTION:
Original ASMR cleaning sounds (record in-camera) + trending upbeat music
(use licensed track or original composition that matches cleaning pace).
Alternatively, use trending TikTok audio 'Build Yourself Up' or similar
uplifting track that peaks at 1.5s."
```

### Example 2: Comedy Skit Hook

```
Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）提示：

"Create a 15-second comedy skit with hook optimized for maximum laugh
in first 2 seconds. TikTok/Reels format.

HOOK STRUCTURE (First 2 seconds):
[0.0-0.2s] Open on character in normal situation, indoors (kitchen,
office, bedroom). Camera is still, character seems calm. Lighting is
neutral. No music yet. Sound: ambient room tone (very quiet).

[0.2-0.6s] Character speaks directly to camera: 'I just realized
something...' or 'You know what's crazy?' Confused/thoughtful expression.
Short pause (0.2s silence). Sound: minimal, maybe subtle comedic
underscore building.

[0.6-1.2s] Character delivers absurd statement or observation with
complete seriousness: 'I've been putting my pants on wrong my entire life'
or 'My cat is probably a spy' or 'I think I'm a wizard but nobody noticed'.
Character's delivery is deadpan, completely serious. No laugh track yet.
Sound: comedic underscore, maybe subtle 'ding' sound effect at absurd
statement.

[1.2-2.0s] Immediate cut to visual proof or demonstration of absurdity.
Character demonstrates the 'wrong' way they've been doing it (exaggerated,
ridiculous). OR cut to character doing something wizard-like (wand hand
gestures, levitation attempt). The visual is obviously absurd/silly.
At 1.5s, on-screen text appears: '[ABSURD CLAIM]' or 'WAIT...' Character's
reaction shows they're serious/confused why it's not working/amazed by
their own discovery. Sound: laugh track at 1.5s, comedic sound effects
matching the action (whoosh for wizard attempt, silly music sting for
realization).

FULL VIDEO (Seconds 2-15):
[2-5s] Escalation: character tries again, fails in even more absurd way.
Self-awareness moment (character realizes the absurdity). Physical comedy:
falling, losing balance, exaggerated movements.

[5-10s] Character asks camera for help: 'Can someone help me? Am I crazy?'
or 'This should be ILLEGAL.' Reaction from friend/family member (shocked,
laughing, equally confused). Their reaction validates the comedy.

[10-15s] Final punchline/resolution: character proves their absurd claim
is true in completely unexpected way (something genuinely impressive happens,
but delivered through the absurd lens). OR: character gives up and walks
away with exaggerated defeat. Text overlay at end: 'COMMENT IF YOU'VE DONE
THIS TOO' or 'SAVE THIS FOR YOUR [FRIEND]'.

TECHNICAL SPECS:
- Format: 9:16 vertical
- Camera: static or slow pan (not shaky)
- Lighting: bright, even (studio setup or natural window light)
- Audio: minimal underscore until 1.2s, then comedic sounds
- Laugh track: USE sparingly (0.3s laugh at 1.5s and 2.3s maximum)
- Text: One main text at 1.5s (the absurd claim or reaction)
- No special effects needed (comedy relies on character, not effects)
- Pacing: slow setup 0-1.2s, then quick payoff 1.2-2s

EDITING NOTES:
- Camera should be close enough to see character's face clearly
- Expressions are EVERYTHING (deadpan delivery of absurdity is the joke)
- Cut quickly at comedic moment (don't linger)
- No background music before 0.6s (let dialog stand alone)
- Laugh track should feel organic (not canned)
- Consider: B-roll of character's absurd idea to reinforce joke

CHARACTER PERFORMANCE TIPS:
- Deadpan delivery of absurd claims (the contradiction is the joke)
- Slight pause before punchline (lets the setup land)
- Immediate reaction to self-awareness (realizing how absurd the claim is)
- Genuine confusion/amazement in demonstration attempts
- Physical comedy should feel authentic (not theatrical)

CAPTION SUGGESTION:
'POV: You realize you've been doing this wrong the whole time. #RelatablyDumb
#ComedySkit #DeadpanHumor'

HASHTAG STRATEGY:
- #FYP #ForYouPage (algorithm)
- #ComedySkit (category)
- #Relatable (engagement driver)
- #DeadpanHumor (niche community)

AUDIO SUGGESTION:
Minimal underscore (tension building) + comedic sound effects (no need for
trending audio; original character voice is better)."
```

### Example 5: Impossible Visual Hook

```
Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）提示：

"Create a 45-second 'impossible' visual with hook that makes viewers say
'HOW IS THAT POSSIBLE?' at 2-second mark. All platforms format.

HOOK STRUCTURE (First 2 seconds):
[0.0-0.2s] Open on seemingly normal scene: person, object, or space that
appears natural at first. Camera is steady or slow-moving. Lighting is
natural-looking. Sound: ambient (quiet background noise) with subtle tension
music underneath.

[0.2-0.7s] Introduce the ANOMALY: something appears that shouldn't exist
or be possible. It's subtle at first (viewers might not notice the abnormality
immediately). Example: person standing on ceiling in normal lighting (gravity
seeming normal from the perspective), object floating without support,
animal doing impossible thing, person duplicated/clone in scene. At 0.5s,
on-screen text appears: 'WAIT...' or 'HOLD ON...' or 'LOOK CLOSER'. Sound:
music builds, slightly tense.

[0.7-1.5s] MOMENT OF REALIZATION: camera angle shifts, cut changes, or
zoom reveals the impossibility. Viewer's brain says 'that's not physically
possible.' Example: camera pulls back showing the person is on ceiling and
gravity is inverted, object hovers in midair with no support, animal is
impossibly scaled. At 1.0s, on-screen text: 'HOW???' or 'THIS ISN'T REAL'
or '[THING] IS IMPOSSIBLE'. Viewer is now 100% invested in learning HOW.
Sound: dramatic music sting, whoosh effect, or ascending tone marking the
moment of impossibility reveal.

[1.5-2.0s] EXPLANATION HINT: brief hint that there's an explanation or
reveal coming. Could be: camera pans to show green screen, person looks at
camera with knowing smile, text says 'HERE'S THE TRICK', or cut to behind-
the-scenes showing how it's done. Don't reveal the full trick yet—just hint
that it's explainable. Sound: music sustains tension, maybe slight comedic
undertone (viewers might laugh at the trick). Viewer thinks: 'I HAVE to
keep watching to learn how they did this.'

FULL VIDEO (Seconds 2-45):
[2-10s] EXPAND THE IMPOSSIBILITY: show the impossible thing from multiple
angles, prove it's consistent, escalate the impossibility. Person on ceiling
walks around, other objects fall upward, camera rotates to show full
inverted reality. Build belief that it's somehow real. Music continues
tension. Text: 'THIS IS REAL' or repeated 'HOW???' Viewer is fully committed
to learning the explanation.

[10-20s] FULL EXPOSITION: reveal the behind-the-scenes. Show the camera
trick (it's filmed upside down), the special effects (CGI or green screen),
the practical effect (hidden wires, rotating set). Use quick cuts showing
before/after of the effect. Split-screen showing the trick setup and the
final result. Music lightens (explanation = relief). Text explains the method.

[20-30s] RE-WATCH THE ORIGINAL: play the hook again (0-2s footage again)
but now viewer knows the trick. They're amazed at how seamless it was.
Maybe slow-motion playback showing the details they missed first time.
Music becomes satisfying/impressive (how clever the trick is). Text:
'CLEVER RIGHT?' or 'YOU FELL FOR IT' or 'THAT'S HOW THEY DID IT'.

[30-45s] ESCALATION OR SECOND TRICK: Creator tries an even MORE impossible
thing, or attempts to trick viewer again. Or: blooper reel showing failed
attempts. Or: creator explains how they came up with the trick. Music becomes
playful/entertaining. Viewer stays for the additional content. Final text:
'SAVE THIS TO TRY IT YOURSELF' or 'WHO ELSE WANTS TO TRY?' Call-to-action
invites shares and comments.

TECHNICAL SPECS:
- Format: 9:16 vertical
- Camera: extremely steady (gimbal, tripod, or perfectly stable)
- Lighting: professional, even, bright (impossible effects need clear light)
- Special Effects:
  * Practical (physical setup, rotation, wires): real-time in camera
  * Inverted world: shoot upside-down then rotate in post
  * Green screen: crisp keying, no artifacts
  * CGI: professional level (not obviously fake)
- Audio: tension music → explanation music → playful music (arc)
- Transitions: quick cuts when explaining, slow shots when showing impossible
  effect
- Pacing: SLOW during impossible reveal (let it sink in), FAST during
  explanation (maintain energy)

EDITING NOTES:
- First hook (0-2s) must be seamless and believable (don't let technical
  errors show)
- Behind-the-scenes should be clear but not too educational (focus on 'wow
  they got me' not technical details)
- Color grade: cool/slightly off-putting during impossibility phase, normal

- Slow-motion playback of original hook (at 30s mark) is incredibly satisfying
- Include genuine failed attempts in blooper section (humanizes creator,

CAMERA/TECHNICAL SETUP DEPENDS ON METHOD:

- Or: film upside-down, rotate footage in post
- Ensure no shadows/lighting betray the inversion initially
- Reveal the rotation as explanation

GREEN SCREEN METHOD:

- Composite against impossible background (floating in space, standing on

- Professional keying to avoid artifacts
- Show the before/after split to reveal trick

PRACTICAL RIGGING:
- Use invisible wires, magnets, or physical rigs
- Conceal the support in shadows or blur
- Strong enough to safely support actor/object
- Reveal the rig during explanation

CREATOR PERFORMANCE:
- Stay calm and matter-of-fact during impossible reveal (let the effect
  speak for itself)
- Show genuine pride in the trick reveal
- Make eye contact with camera during explanation
- Show personality (humor, amazement, humility about viewer being tricked)

CAPTION SUGGESTION:

the explanation! #FakeOut #MagicTrick #VisualEffect #HowItsDone'

## Trending Format Templates

Master these templates. Mix them with hook patterns for maximum virality.

### Duet/Stitch Bait
Create a hook that begs someone to respond with their own version.
- Format: ask question, show your answer, make completion satisfying
- Example: "POV: You're told you're [thing] and you have to..." then show your response
- Hook: 0-2s shows the setup/question, forces response

### POV (Point of View) Format
Viewer experiences the scenario as if they're the subject.
- Format: "POV: You just did [embarrassing/amazing/shocking thing]"
- Hook: 0-2s shows the consequence or reaction to viewer's action
- Audio: often uses second-person voice ("you did this", "you just realized")

### Put a Finger Down
Interactive format: "put a finger down if you've ever..."
- Format: list increasingly specific or embarrassing statements, viewer judges self
- Hook: 0-2s shows first 2-3 "finger down" statements
- Engagement: incredibly high (viewers mentally participate)

### GRWM (Get Ready With Me)
Getting ready while sharing information or entertainment.
- Format: person gets ready while delivering content
- Hook: 0-2s shows person at start of routine, hints at what will be shared
- Retention: naturally high (viewers want to see the finished look)

### Day in the Life
Following routine from start to finish, showing lifestyle or job.
- Format: morning-to-night or start-to-finish of specific task
- Hook: 0-2s shows most dramatic moment or biggest reveal from the day
- Often uses: time-stamps, montage pace

### ASMR Mukbang
Eating/drinking while producing satisfying sounds.
- Format: close-up of food, macro audio, minimal talking
- Hook: 0-2s shows most delicious-looking bite or crunchiest sound
- Audio is primary (ASMR satisfying eating sounds)

### Trend Hijack
Take trending audio/dance/format and put your own spin.
- Format: use trending audio but with unexpected content
- Hook: 0-2s establishes the trend, then subverts expectation
- Example: trending dance audio plays, but person is doing mundane activity while dancing

### Tutorial/How-To
Teaching someone to do something.
- Format: problem setup, step-by-step solution, reveal final result
- Hook: 0-2s shows the problem and hints that solution is simple/surprising
- Pacing: quick cuts through steps (montage-style)

### Transition Challenge
Person transforms from one state to another using trending audio/music.
- Format: cut on beat of music showing before/after or different versions of same person
- Hook: 0-2s shows first state and hints transformation is coming
- Audio must have clear beat to cut on

## Analytics-Driven Optimization

The first 2 seconds matter, but data tells you if your hook is working.

### Key Metrics to Track

**Watch Time %:**
- 100% watch time = flawless hook + retention
- 90%+ = strong hook, most viewers stay
- 80-90% = good hook, some drop-off mid-video
- <80% = hook isn't working or video body is weak

**Watch time dips reveal retention problems:**
- If 50% drop off at 3 seconds = hook isn't delivering on its promise
- If 70% drop off at 10 seconds = hook works but video body weak
- If completion rate increases after 15 seconds = audience is invested (narrative is working)

**First 3 seconds Metric:**
- Average click-through rate (CTR) = (clicks / impressions) × 100
- Higher CTR = better hook (platform shows it to more people)
- TikTok average CTR for new creators: 3-5%
- Viral threshold: 8%+ (algorithm boost kicks in)

**Audience Retention:**
- TikTok/YouTube Studio shows exactly where viewers drop off
- If dip at 1.5 seconds = hook promised something not delivered
- If dip at 5 seconds = hook works but premise isn't interesting
- If flat retention = hook AND content both working

### Iteration Based on Data

**If 0-2s has <70% retention:**
- Hook is weak. Try stronger pattern interrupt.
- Audio isn't compelling. Try trending audio or ASMR.
- Opening frame is unclear. Try extreme close-up or bold movement.
- Text isn't clear. Increase text size/contrast.

**If 2-5s has high drop-off (retention falls from 80% to 40%):**
- Hook promised something not delivered.
- Pacing after hook is too slow.
- Context/explanation takes too long.
- Solution: deliver on hook promise faster, cut to payoff at 3s.

**If 5-15s has declining retention:**
- Hook works, but video body is weak.
- Curiosity isn't sustained past initial hook.
- Add secondary hook at 5s (mini-cliff before resolution).
- Increase visual energy or emotional escalation.

**If retention increases after 15s:**
- Slow-burn narrative is working (emotional story, tutorial, reveal).
- Don't cut video short; let it fully develop.
- First hook doesn't need to be as aggressive (video body is compelling).

### A/B Testing Hooks

Create 2-3 versions of same content with different hooks:

**Version A:** Curiosity gap hook (half-reveal)
**Version B:** Emotional trigger hook (fear, awe, cute)
**Version C:** Visual shock hook (impossible physics, color explosion)

Post each to separate accounts or same account at different times. Compare:
- First 3-second CTR
- Completion rate %
- Average watch time

Whichever wins = that hook mechanism works best for your audience/content category.

### Platform-Specific Metrics

**TikTok:**
- Track: completion rate %, average watch time, like-share rate
- Viral signal: 80%+ completion rate + 8%+ engagement rate
- Algorithm boost kicks in at 80k+ impressions with high completion

**Instagram Reels:**
- Track: saves, shares, comments (more valuable than views)
- Viral signal: save-to-view ratio >5% or share-to-view ratio >2%
- Saves indicate 'want to come back to this'

**YouTube Shorts:**
- Track: average view duration, click-through rate to full video
- Viral signal: 60%+ of viewers click to full video or subscribe
- Retention curves show drop-off patterns clearly

## Common Mistakes & Fixes

### Mistake 1: The False Promise Hook
**Problem:** Hook promises something exciting, video doesn't deliver.
Example: hook shows impossible physics moment, full video is boring talking-head explanation.

**Fix:** Deliver on the hook within 5 seconds. The hook is a promise; breaking that promise causes algorithm penalty and viewer rage-quit.

### Mistake 2: Starting With Talking Head
**Problem:** First 2 seconds is person talking to camera with no visual interest.
Example: "Hey guys, so today I want to talk about..." [SWIPE]

**Fix:** Start with visual shock or action. Talking heads lose 80% of viewers by 2 seconds. If you must have voiceover, pair it with compelling visuals.

### Mistake 3: No Sound
**Problem:** Hook is visually interesting but silent or has quiet ambient sound.

**Fix:** Sound is 50% of impact. Add ASMR, music, or sound effects. Silence is only powerful if followed by sudden loud sound (strategic silence → impact).

### Mistake 4: Bad Audio Quality
**Problem:** Voiceover is muffled, background noise is loud, or sound is imbalanced.

**Fix:** Invest in good microphone. Audio quality signals professionalism (or lack thereof). Bad audio = faster bounce rate.

### Mistake 5: Shaky Camera
**Problem:** First frame of hook shows unstable camera movement that's distracting.

**Fix:** Use tripod, gimbal, or extremely steady hand. If you want movement, make it intentional and smooth (not jittery/nervous).

### Mistake 6: Text That's Too Small or Low Contrast
**Problem:** On-screen text is unreadable on mobile phone.

**Fix:** Large font, bold weight, high contrast (white on black, black on bright). Test on actual phone. If you squint, text is too small.

### Mistake 7: Hook Takes Too Long
**Problem:** Hook doesn't hook until 5+ seconds in.

**Fix:** First 2 seconds is do-or-die. If your hook takes 5 seconds to set up, lose the setup. Get straight to the interesting part.

### Mistake 8: Trending Audio Mismatch
**Problem:** Using trending audio that doesn't match the hook's vibe.
Example: sad story with upbeat dancing music.

**Fix:** Audio must match emotional tone. If using trending audio, ensure it aligns with your hook's message/feeling.

### Mistake 9: Over-Edited Hook
**Problem:** So many effects, transitions, and cuts that the actual hook is lost.

**Fix:** Simplicity > complexity. The hook itself is interesting enough. Don't bury it under effects. 1-2 key effects max.

### Mistake 10: Unclear Premise
**Problem:** After watching 2 seconds, viewer has no idea what the video is about.

**Fix:** Context must be clear or curiosity must be burning. "What is this about?" should be answerable or urgently interesting by 2 seconds.

# Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）——打斗场景与动作提示词生成器

掌握激烈的动作编舞转化为生动视频提示词的艺术，用于Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）。此技能教你用电影精确、内脏冲击和节奏的韵律来制作打斗场景，感觉既动态又有目的。

---

## Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）技术规格

Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）擅长渲染：

- **动态运动与势能**：角色自然加速进入打击，保持逼真的物理
- **环境互动**：武器和冲击与灰尘、水、碎片和可破坏元素互动
- **动作期间的照明**：冲击时闪光、枪口闪光、元素效果投射逼真的阴影
- **多角色编舞**：多个角色之间的适当间距、遮挡和同时动作
- **武器清晰度**：剑、员工、枪和武术武器以独特的重量和延伸运动
- **力碰撞**：吸收冲击；破损动画；角色因打击而反应
- **相机工作**：跟踪、绕行、撤回以显示环境或靠近
- **运动模糊与速度**：传达速度和影响的视觉线索
- **后期效果**：击中闪光、血液、吸烟、能量爆炸

---

## 打斗场景的2秒钩子框架

打斗的力量来自即时的视觉和物理承诺。前两秒应该表达：

1. **对手身份与距离**——我在看谁打谁？
2. **武器或武术风格**——这是什么类型的战斗？
3. **能量和节奏**——打斗是快速和敏捷还是力量和重量感？

### 框架

```
[0–0.5秒]: [对手建立] + [距离/武器] + [光照强度]
[0.5–1秒]: [初始动作/转向] + [速度提示]
[1–2秒]: [冲击或动作转向] + [音频/视觉反应]
```

### 例子1：拳击快速组合

```
0–0.5秒：两个对手，拳击姿态，面对面。白色擂台灯光。高对比度阴影。
0.5–1秒：一个对手快速出拳。相机锐利地关注。运动模糊。
1–2秒：冲击。对手头向后闪。出汗喷溅。冲击闪光。
```

### 例子2：剑斗长式

```
0–1秒：两个战士，剑拔，对峙。城堡背景。戏剧性的侧光。
1–2秒：缓慢、意图的剑对。击打声。火花。叮当声。
```

### 例子3：高功能功夫

```
0–1秒：打手，宽站立，准备。中国建筑。日光。
1–2秒：闪电式旋转踢。速度线。功夫音效（哈！）。气旋效果。
```

---

## 打斗场景语言架构

### 第1层：战斗类型和战斗机制

#### 战斗分类

| 战斗类型 | 特征 | 视觉承诺 | 音效 |
|---------|------|--------|------|
| **拳击/MMA** | 快速，爆炸性，力量驱动 | 模糊运动，冲击闪光 | 打击声，呼吸，垫子碰撞 |
| **武术（功夫/空手道）** | 流动，精确，线性 | 速度线，旋转，踢腿延伸 | "哈！"音效，击中声，吸入 |
| **剑术（刀/剑）** | 意图，重量，碰撞 | 缓慢而强大的弧线，火花 | 叮当声，切割声，金属摩擦 |
| **枪战** | 快速，爆炸性，远程 | 枪口闪光，子弹轨迹，烟雾 | 枪声，壳弹落下，嗖声 |
| **赤手空拳/街头战斗** | 混乱，激烈，肮脏 | 笨拙，绝望的能量 | 粗暴的打击，痛苦的叫声，摔跤 |
| **体操/特技战斗** | 浮华，高飞，精准 | 翻滚，技巧，轻盈的着陆 | 垫子碰撞，呼吸，空中嗖声 |
| **超级英雄动作** | 过度夸大，力量驱动，VFX重型 | 能量爆炸，闪光，故事板风格 | 低频爆炸，能量嗡鸣，撞击 |

### 第2层：打击力学和物理

#### 打击类型和视觉特性

```
直接/刺击 →
- 视觉：线性加速，尖锐的加速和停止
- 运动：无弧形，完全力量到目标
- 音频：清晰的冲击；可能的击穿声

挥动/扫动 →
- 视觉：圆弧运动，延伸，跟进
- 运动：旋转肩膀或臀部；生成力量
- 音频：弧线，沉闷的冲击

切割/切割 →
- 视觉：锐利的角度，清晰的刀锋，可能的出血或切割效果
- 运动：刀锋优先，边缘对目标
- 音频：切割声或金属声

冲击/尖刺 →
- 视觉：肩膀优先，腰部扭转，目标吸收冲击
- 运动：身体对线，全重
- 音频：深沉的低频冲击
```

#### 碰撞物理

```
硬碰撞（金属对金属）→
火花、反弹、可能的武器弹开
声音：叮当声、铃声

柔软碰撞（拳头对身体）→
肉体吸收打击；身体反应向后或向侧面
声音：沉闷的打击声、可能的呼吸出去

部分碰撞（打击但被阻挡）→
两个武器碰撞；可能的火花或紧张
声音：冲击加上金属声
```

### 第3层：对手运动和反应

#### 攻防循环

每个打斗都是动作和反应的循环：

```
1. 设置和缓冲（0.2秒）：
   攻击者准备，肌肉拉紧，体重转移

2. 执行和延伸（0.3秒）：
   全力打击；运动弧；速度达到峰值

3. 冲击（0.1秒）：
   目标接触；可能的闪光或效果

4. 反应（0.2秒）：
   防守者向后闪；可能的防御；可能的反击

5. 恢复（0.2秒）：
   两个对手都重新定位；呼吸；准备下一轮
```

#### 多角色同步

对于两个以上的对手：

```
"三个对手混乱：
- 对手A攻击对手B的左侧
- 对手B防守A同时攻击对手C
- 对手C闪避B同时攻击A
所有动作应该显示互动和间距意识。"
```

### 第4层：武器特定细节

#### 刀和剑

```
剑设计：
- 刀锋宽度：刀锋应该清晰可见
- 动作弧：挥动刀剑应该有圆形，从肩膀到手腕
- 转向和位置：刀应该在每次打击前进行位置调整
- 火花和冲击：金属碰撞时产生火花
- 旗帜：重的剑在快速交换中不会那么快（物理权重）

提示词：
"剑看起来有重量。挥动是有力但不是即时的。
碰撞时的金属火花。叮当声。刀片清晰可见。"
```

#### 空手搏击和武术武器（员工、锯、镐）

```
员工/长武器：
- 旋转和花式动作
- 广泛的范围
- 需要身体动力（核心、肩膀、腿）
- 运动应该是流体的

提示词：
"员工使用流体旋转。宽泛的范围。
很少的暂停；运动是连续的。
击中所有目标，旋转的冲量很好。"
```

#### 拳击和赤手空拳

```
拳头和拳打：
- 快速组合（3-5连击无暂停）
- 脚工作很关键（前后摇晃、枢轴）
- 变化：直拳、钩拳、上勾拳
- 防守：躲闪、滑步、格挡

提示词：
"拳击组合：直拳、右钩、左上勾。
脚步工作在地板上。躲闪对手的计数器。
全力拳击；可见的冲击。呼吸困难。"
```

#### 枪战

```
枪火指南：
- 枪口闪光（来自枪的亮光爆发）
- 子弹和烟雾（可见或暗示）
- 后坐力和肩膀反冲
- 声音延迟（大枪声；可能的回声）
- 射弹命中（冲击、火花、穿孔）

提示词：
"枪口闪光在每次射击时。枪后坐力，肩膀反冲。
烟雾滞后，吹过风景。
目标被命中；冲击反应。"
```

### 第5层：相机工作和视角

#### 动作相机技术

| 技术 | 效果 | 用途 |
|------|------|------|
| **跟踪** | 相机跟随攻击者 | 让观众与打击者一起 |
| **绕行/圆周运动** | 相机旋转对手周围 | 显示环境和空间 |
| **推进** | 相机靠近冲击 | 增强影响感 |
| **撤回** | 相机拉回以显示整个场景 | 显示规模和对手位置 |
| **快速切割** | 多个角度的快速跳跃 | 上升的紧张和兴奋 |
| **缓慢/快速镜头** | 某些时刻在120fps或250fps | 强调关键冲击或技巧 |

#### 在打斗中应用相机语言

```
开口：宽镜头。两个对手相距远。建立空间。
初始交换：跟踪镜头。相机跟随攻击者的动作。
高峰冲击：推进。超级特写。冲击感。
快速交换：快速切割。多个角度。升级兴奋。
呼吸时刻：撤回。两个对手都看到。沉默。
高潮：缓慢镜头。关键技巧或击倒。冲击放大。
```

### 第6层：音频设计和节奏

#### 打斗音效

```
直接打击 → "噼啪"（轻），"砰"（中），"砰砰"（重）
武器碰撞 → "叮当"（金属），"咔"（木材）
脚步工作 → 地板冲击，脚工作节奏
呼吸和痛苦声 → 吸入，呼吸，呼吸困难
环境 → 风，雨（如果外面），在线程绳上的挂起感
```

#### 配乐同步

打斗应该与配乐的节拍同步：

```
缓慢配乐（120 BPM）→ 缓慢、意图的打斗。力量。
中等配乐（140 BPM）→ 平衡的速度。打斗和恢复。
快速配乐（180+ BPM）→ 快速组合。能量爆炸。
无配乐 → 所有焦点都放在音效和呼吸上。原始。
```

---

## 完整提示词模板

### 标准打斗场景

```
[对手]: [角色名称或类型]（例如拳击手、武术大师、剑士）
[战斗类型]: [拳击/武术/剑术/枪战/混合]
[环境]: [位置]（擂台、街道、森林、室内）
[打光]: [时间]和[日光或人造光]。打光强度：[高对比度/柔软]
[打斗节奏]:
  - 开始：[设置和缓冲时间]
  - 第一次交换：[初始打击类型和数量]
  - 升级：[变化和强度增加]
  - 高峰：[关键冲击或技巧]
  - 恢复/结束：[如何打斗结束]
[武器]:
  [如果适用] 武器：[类型]。[材质]。[视觉效果]
  打击声：[声音描述]。火花：[是/否]。
[相机工作]:
  - 开始：[宽角，建立]
  - 中间：[跟踪，绕行]
  - 高峰：[推进，特写]
  - 恢复：[撤回或稳定]
[音频]:
  - 配乐：[节奏和强度]
  - SFX：[打击声、脚步、呼吸]
  - 反应声（可选）：[呼吸困难、痛苦]
[VFX]:
  - 冲击闪光：[是/否，强度]
  - 汗水/血液：[强度]
  - 尘埃或碎片：[是/否]
  - 能量效果（超级英雄）：[描述]
[持续时间]: [秒数，通常2-6秒]
[节奏感]: [快速和令人兴奋 / 缓慢而强大 / 混合]
```

### 快速打斗参考

#### 拳击快速交换

```
两个拳击手，快速组合。
打击：直拳、钩拳、上勾拳。重复。
反应：躲闪、防守、反击。
速度：非常快。运动模糊可见。
音效：打击声、脚步、呼吸困难。
配乐：140+ BPM，鼓声驱动。
持续时间：3-4秒。高能量。
```

#### 剑对剑决斗

```
两个剑士，中等距离。
第一次交换：缓慢的试探性打击。评估。
升级：更快的打击。打击率增加。
高峰：快速的击打序列。火花。
音效：金属叮当声、沉重呼吸。
配乐：戏剧性、意图、建设。
持续时间：4-6秒。权力和精准。
```

#### 多个对手混乱

```
三个战士，自由格斗。
对手A vs B，C想加入。
动作：快速、混乱、交叉打击。
相机：快速切割多个角度。
音效：同时的打击，脚步混乱。
配乐：快速，兴奋，无秩序感。
持续时间：3-5秒。高能量混乱。
```

---

## 高级优化

### 1. 打斗序列与故事节奏

```
对于长的打斗（6秒以上），创造节奏变化：
- 开始：缓慢建立（1秒）
- 升级1：增加速度（1秒）
- 升级2：打击率增加（1-2秒）
- 高峰：最快速度（1秒）
- 呼吸时刻：暂停，重新设置（0.5秒）
- 最终升级：最后一次交换或结束（1秒）
```

### 2. 受伤和反应动画

```
轻击：对手摇晃头部，回到立场。无真正的影响。
中等打击：对手后退一步或两步。可能会失去焦点。
重打击：对手被击倒或击倒。下降动画。恢复缓慢。
击倒：对手在地上。可能无意识。可能需要帮助起床。
```

### 3. 多个打斗场景序列

```
如果连续生成多个打斗（一个打斗系列）：
- 保持相同的角色模型（使用@material参考）
- 保持相同的位置或环境
- 保持相同的打斗风格和技巧
- 在后续打斗中显示进展（疲劳、伤害、学习）
```

---

## 常见陷阱

| 问题 | 原因 | 解决方案 |
|------|------|---------|
| 打斗看起来缓慢无力 | 缺乏冲击反应；运动太分散 | 添加"可见的冲击"；"对手反应" |
| 不清楚谁在赢 | 没有优势或劣势指示 | 显示一个对手压倒或防守另一个 |
| 武器看起来轻或塑料 | 没有重量提示或碰撞反应 | 添加"武器有重量"；"碰撞反应" |
| 相机工作令人困惑 | 太多的角度或不连贯的视角 | 简化为跟踪或绕行；避免过度切割 |
| 音效不同步 | 音效和冲击没有很好地对齐 | 指定"冲击同步到音效" |
| 打斗显示过多或过少 | 提示不清楚持续时间或节奏 | 明确指定秒数和节奏变化 |

---

## 提示工程检查清单

- [ ] 战斗类型是否清晰明确？（拳击/剑/等等）
- [ ] 是否明确指定了打斗节奏？（快速/缓慢/混合）
- [ ] 相机工作是否有意图？（跟踪、推进、绕行）
- [ ] 对手反应是否指定了吗？（躲闪、防守、受伤）
- [ ] 音效和配乐是否同步？
- [ ] 环境是否清晰（地点和打光）？
- [ ] 是否有冲击反应或伤害指示？
- [ ] 持续时间是否现实的打斗长度？

---

## 快速参考

### 5分钟打斗提示

```
标准打斗：
两个对手，[战斗风格]。[环境]。
快速交换。冲击可见。反应大。
相机跟踪。配乐[快/慢]。
[3-4秒]。[高/中]能量。

多角色：
三个对手，混乱的自由格斗。
同时的打击。快速切割相机。
高能量。没有休息。[3-5秒]。

高级技巧：
一个角色执行复杂的技巧。
缓慢动作强调精准。
环境反应（尘埃、碎片）。
[2-3秒]。[精准驱动]。
```

---

## 最后的建议

伟大的打斗场景不仅仅是快速的运动——它们是**关于力量、重量和对手之间的互动**。最好的打斗让您感受到每一次打击的冲击和每个对手的努力。

使用这个框架来构建您的对手，它们的能力，以及他们的意图。其余的会自然而然地跟随。

records.readme_markdown:
# Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）——电影级胶片风格提示词生成器

欢迎使用终极指南，在 Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）上制作大片质量的视频提示词。此技能将您的创意愿景转化为精确的制片级提示词，生成惊人的电影序列。

---

## Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）接受的内容

**输入规格：**
- **图像：** 最多9张图像（参考资料、故事板、情绪板、角色设计、位置照片）
- **视频：** 最多3个视频片段（现有素材、转场、运动参考）
- **音频：** 最多3个音频文件（音乐轨道、音效、对白录音、环境音床）
- **文本：** 完整的提示词描述和规格说明
- **组合资源：** 所有类别中最多12个项目
- **输出时长：** 4-15秒的720p视频，带同步音频
- **特殊语法：** `@material[名称]`参考提示词中上传的参考资料

**输出特性：**
- 高质量720p视频，完整音频集成
- 与输入音频的精确时间同步
- 运动尊重提供的参考资料
- 顺序请求间的一致渲染

---

## 2秒钩子框架

电影级视频的成功取决于前两秒的吸引力。这个框架帮助您设计引人入胜的开场。

### 核心概念

**钩子 = 一个强有力的视觉承诺 + 独特的美学声明**

前两秒应该清楚地传达：
1. **视觉类型**（这是什么类型的图像？）
2. **情感基调**（感觉如何？）
3. **运动承诺**（接下来会发生什么？）

### 2秒钩子框架模板

```
[MOMENT 0–1秒]: [视觉冲击] + [打光特征]
[MOMENT 1–2秒]: [摄像机运动] + [深度线索]
```

### 电影级钩子的例子

**例子1：黑色电影悬念**
```
MOMENT 0–0.5秒: 暗淡的红霓虹灯反射在湿润的街道。高对比度，多雾。
MOMENT 0.5–1秒: 特写镜头从眼睛拉出，揭示一张受伤的脸庞。柔软的焦点边缘。
MOMENT 1–2秒: 稳定摄像机平推右侧，深度雾化层。
```

**例子2：科幻史诗**
```
MOMENT 0–1秒: 一个宏大的未来城市天际线，极致景深，远处城市模糊。金色日落。
MOMENT 1–2秒: 吊臂镜头向上升起，揭示城市的规模。数字光线扫过摩天大楼。
```

**例子3：浪漫驾驶场景**
```
MOMENT 0–1秒: 一辆复古敞篷车从观众身边驶过，侧面对光。镜头光晕。
MOMENT 1–2秒: 切到车内，角色头转，金色小时光线透过窗户。景深浅。
```

---

## 电影级视频的语言架构

### 第1层：摄像机语言

#### 摄像机类型和运动

| 技术 | 定义 | 何时使用 |
|------|------|---------|
| **稳定摄像机推进** | 缓慢、流畅的向前或向后移动 | 戏剧性揭示，建立镜头，情感时刻 |
| **推车镜头** | 侧向滑动运动，通常跟踪主体 | 跟随角色，展示场景深度 |
| **吊臂镜头** | 向上或向下的弧形运动 | 建立全景，揭示环境规模 |
| **旋转** | 围绕轴旋转 | 揭示环境信息，戏剧性转折 |
| **变焦** | 焦距变化（光学或数字） | 强调重要元素，快速转向 |
| **空中无人机镜头** | 从高角度的宽视图 | 大规模场景，位置建立，追逐 |
| **过肩镜头** | 在主体肩膀上拍摄 | 对话、对抗、互动时刻 |
| **低角镜头** | 从下往上拍摄 | 权力、胁迫、威胁感 |
| **高角镜头** | 从上往下拍摄 | 弱点、脆弱性、孤立感 |

### 第2层：打光设计

#### 打光基调和风格

| 风格 | 特征 | 常见应用 |
|------|------|---------|
| **高键打光** | 明亮、均匀、最少阴影 | 希望、安全、乐观场景 |
| **低键打光** | 高对比度、戏剧性阴影、黑暗区域 | 神秘、危险、悬念、恐怖 |
| **电影比例** | 3:1至5:1的键盘对填充比例 | 标准电影外观，深度感 |
| **环境光/背光** | 从后面照亮主体的光 | 分离主体从背景，三维感 |
| **单色打光** | 仅使用一个关键光源 | 戏剧性、强调形式、风格化 |
| **多色打光** | 冷暖对比的多个光源 | 复杂的情感、动态场景 |
| **практический光** | 火焰、霓虹、灯光等源光 | 现实感、位置真实性 |

#### 打光颜色心理学

```
金色/琥珀色小时光线 → 温暖、怀旧、浪漫
冷蓝色 → 孤立、科幻、不安
红色/橙色 → 紧张、危险、激情
绿色 → 不自然、病态、科幻
单色黑白 → 永恒、经典、强调形式
```

### 第3层：色彩分级和心理学

#### 色彩调色板的战略使用

```
暖色调（金色、琥珀色、红色） →
- 使用场景: 日出、篝火、家内场景、 flashback
- 情感: 温暖、安全、怀旧、爱

冷色调（蓝色、青色、紫色） →
- 使用场景: 夜间、海水、科幻、死亡场景
- 情感: 孤立、神秘、不安、超越

脱色/褪色（低饱和度） →
- 使用场景: 战争电影、心理戏剧、记忆
- 情感: 绝望、厌倦、年龄感

高饱和度鲜艳 →
- 使用场景: 动作、冒险、喜剧
- 情感: 能量、兴奋、戏剧性
```

### 第4层：景深（DOF）和焦点

#### 景深策略

| 策略 | 视觉效果 | 情感影响 |
|------|---------|---------|
| **浅景深（f/1.4–f/2.8）** | 锐利主体，模糊背景 | 隔离、亲密、关注 |
| **中等景深（f/2.8–f/5.6）** | 主体和一些背景清晰 | 平衡的重点 |
| **深景深（f/8+）** | 所有内容清晰 | 环境意识、全景信息 |
| **移动焦点** | 焦点在拍摄过程中转移 | 揭示信息、引导注意力 |
| **光学光晕** | 背景光线漂亮失焦 | 电影质量、梦幻、浪漫 |

### 第5层：运动设计和节奏

#### 运动类型和意义

```
线性运动 → 目的、决定性、前进动力
抛物线运动 → 自然、流体、优雅
角运动 → 冲击、速度、紧张
缓冲运动 → 重量、权力、物理性
突发运动 → 惊吓、能量、冲击
```

### 第6层：使用参考资料

在电影级美学中有效利用 @material 参考。

#### 纹理参考

```
prompt = "以@material[wood_texture]为主体的桌面，配合@material[leather_chair]。
柔软的侧光刮掉纹理细节。电影比例3:1。"
```

#### 色彩参考

```
prompt = "未来派城市天际线，融合@material[cyberpunk_color_palette]的色彩。
金色和深紫色霓虹灯。背光环境照明。"
```

#### 运动参考

```
prompt = "从@video[slow_dolly_example]采用稳定摄像机运动风格。
以柔和的焦点和电影级过渡。"
```

---

## 完整提示词模板

### 标准电影级场景模板

```
[场景建立]
在[位置]中，[时间]。[环境描述]。

[视觉设计]
摄像机：[摄像机类型] [摄像机运动]
打光：[关键光源] [打光比例] [打光颜色] 
焦点：[景深选择] [焦点位置]
色彩分级：[调色板描述]

[动作和进展]
[时间码0–1秒]: [动作/变化]
[时间码1–2秒]: [摄像机动作/揭示]
[时间码2–]: [高潮/转折]

[情感基调]
[基调和心情]

[@material参考]
参考：@material[name1]，@material[name2]
```

### 示例1：黑色电影夜间场景

```
场景：下雨的城市街道，午夜。潮湿的水泥反射霓虹灯。

视觉设计：
摄像机：稳定摄像机推进右侧，跟踪角色
打光：单色关键灯从上方左侧。低键。对比5:1。深蓝色和红色霓虹灯。
焦点：浅景深（f/2.0）。焦点在角色眼睛上。
色彩分级：脱色。阴影中冷蓝色。霓虹灯中高饱和度红色。

动作：
0–1秒：雨滴撞击相机透镜。镜头擦拭。可见被映射的霓虹灯。
1–2秒：摄像机推进角色黑色夹克。雨流下他的脸。
2–4秒：吊臂镜头向上，揭示空荡荡的街道。单个红色霓虹灯招牌。
4–6秒：稳定摄像机旋转，角色转身，戏剧性背光。

情感基调：神秘、危险、孤立。悬念。
```

---

## 高级提示词优化

### 1. 序列性和连续性

要链接多个"胶片场景"以创建连贯的故事：

```
[场景1 - 建立]: 摄像机宽拉。打光建立位置。
[场景2 - 对话]: 切换到过肩镜头。打光和色彩匹配场景1。
[场景3 - 行动]: 吊臂镜头。紧张的音乐。
[场景4 - 高潮]: 快速蒙太奇。明亮的闪光。高对比度。

确保色彩分级跨场景连贯。保持打光逻辑（日光源始终来自同一方向）。
```

### 2. 音频同步

```
prompt = "对话场景。角色说：'这不是你想的那样。'
打光切换到冷蓝色。摄像机缓慢推进。
同步音频节奏：每个句子的关键词前暂停500毫秒。"
```

### 3. VFX 和元素

```
prompt = "科幻操舱。屏幕上的绿色全息元素。
稳定摄像机旋转以跟踪全息图。
强调：全息图闪烁与对话同步。
打光：背光全息图，深蓝色和绿色。"
```

### 4. 特效光学效果

```
prompt = "城市天际线日落。添加镜头光晕效果（15度镜头）。
添加光晕：光点变模糊。
添加光学收差：远距红/青偏移在建筑物边缘。
打光：金色日光。背景模糊。前景尖锐。"
```

---

## 常见陷阱和修复

| 问题 | 原因 | 解决方案 |
|------|------|---------|
| 模糊的视觉 | 打光不清楚 | 指定关键光和填充光比例 |
| 平面感 | 缺乏景深 | 添加浅景深和背景模糊 |
| 不自然的颜色 | 过饱和 | 使用对比冷暖色的色彩分级 |
| 运动看起来急促 | 缓冲不足 | 指定"缓冲进出"和"流体运动" |
| 场景不一致 | 打光和色彩在镜头之间变化 | 创建"打光卡"，为整个序列保持一致 |
| 看不出是什么在发生 | 摄像机太静态 | 添加明显的摄像机运动以引导注意力 |

---

## 提示工程检查清单

在提交电影级提示词之前：

- [ ] 打光情况是否有清晰的关键光源？
- [ ] 是否指定了景深和焦点平面？
- [ ] 摄像机运动是否清晰、有目的？
- [ ] 色彩分级是否支持情感基调？
- [ ] 动作是否在 2 秒内有"吸引力"？
- [ ] 所有参考资料是否被 @material[name] 标记？
- [ ] 时间码是否清晰且现实？
- [ ] 是否有对白或音效的音频同步指导？

---

## 快速风格参考

### 好莱坞大制作

```
关键打光从45度角。清晰的背光。
景深浅（f/2.8）。
摄像机缓慢推进或稳定摄像机。
色彩分级：温暖的金色日光或冷蓝色夜晚。
```

### 电视纪录风格

```
自然打光。环境光。
景深深（f/5.6+）。
偶尔的手持运动。
饱和度较低的色彩分级。
```

### 艺术电影

```
不对称打光。大量阴影。
极端景深选择（非常浅或非常深）。
不寻常的摄像机角度和运动。
富有表现力的色彩分级或单色。
```

### 音乐视频

```
高度风格化的打光。
强大的色彩分级。
动态摄像机运动与音乐同步。
过度饱和或超现实的调色板。
```

---

## 最终提示

电影级胶片制作的秘诀不在于豪华或特殊效果——而在于**意图清晰**。每个灯光、镜头运动和色彩选择都应该为故事或情感服务。

使用这个框架作为你的创意工具包，而不是限制。最伟大的电影常常打破规则，但它们这样做是为了清晰的艺术目的。

祝您Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）上创作精彩！

# Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）——卡通与动画提示词生成器

欢迎使用终极指南，为 Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）创建令人惊艳的卡通和动画风格视频提示词。无论您是制作异想天开的角色动画、充满活力的动作序列还是极简主义的运动图形，此技能提供了框架、模板和深度创意指导，用于生成专注于动画的视频提示词。

## Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）规格

**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）** 是一个针对创建高质量风格化视频内容优化的生成AI视频平台。对于动画工作流，请考虑这些核心规格：

- **原生帧数**：24fps、30fps、48fps、60fps（最适合动画；24fps = 经典剧院感）
- **时长甜蜜点**：2-6秒（比更长序列具有更高的每帧质量）
- **分辨率支持**：1080p、1440p、4K（推荐4K用于详细的手绘风格）
- **色彩深度**：完整8位RGB色彩空间（对于充满活力的卡通调色板至关重要）
- **运动向量**：Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）支持平滑插值和运动模糊选项
- **提示词分词**：详细的风格描述符与动作描述符分开解析
- **迭代预算**：分别测试关键帧和风格变化以加快改进

## 卡通的2秒钩子框架

对于卡通和动画，前两秒应该**建立视觉风格和角色意图**。观众需要立即了解：

1. **美学类型**（这看起来像什么？迪士尼？日本动漫？平面设计？）
2. **角色或主体**（我在看谁或什么？）
3. **运动承诺**（接下来会发生什么？有能量吗？）

### 框架

```
[0–0.5秒]: [美学建立] + [主体展示] + [调色板]
[0.5–1秒]: [第一个动作或表达] + [性格提示]
[1–2秒]: [能量或节奏承诺] + [运动类型]
```

### 例子1：迪士尼风格

```
0–0.5秒：一个友好的棕色兔子，大眼睛，长耳朵。明亮、充满活力的颜色。柔软的线条。
0.5–1秒：兔子转身。大的、富有表现力的眼睛眨眼。微笑。
1–2秒：快速跳跃。弹性动画。运动线。高能量。
```

### 例子2：日本动漫风格

```
0–1秒：一个女孩，大的夸张眼睛，长黑发。赛璐珞着色。高对比度的轮廓。
1–2秒：爆炸式的表达变化。闪光和强调线。分布式背景。
```

### 例子3：扁平设计/极简

```
0–1秒：几何形状。渐变。大而清晰的色块。无轮廓。
1–2秒：形状平滑变换和移动。极小主义运动。
```

---

## 动画美学架构

### 第1层：定义您的卡通风格

#### 经典动画风格

| 风格 | 外观 | 传达的能量 | 常见应用 |
|------|------|----------|--------|
| **迪士尼古典** | 圆润的线条、大眼睛、拟人化动物 | 温暖、友好、可爱 | 儿童内容、角色动画 |
| **日本动漫** | 夸张的表达、大眼睛、高对比度轮廓、分布式背景 | 戏剧性、强烈、有男子气概 | 动作、冒险、浪漫 |
| **欧洲艺术** | 粗糙笔画、不规则线条、成熟的调色板 | 复杂的、知识分子的、古怪的 | 独立电影、文学改编 |
| **赛璐珞着色** | 平坦的颜色、清晰的黑色轮廓、最少的着色 | 电影化的、精美的、经典的 | 动作电影、大制作 |
| **橡皮软管** | 柔软、流体线条、夸张的身体变形 | 卡通化的、幽默的、复古的 | 喜剧、复古、实验 |
| **扁平设计** | 几何形状、没有轮廓、渐变、设计驱动 | 现代、简洁、专业的 | 品牌动画、UI、广告 |
| **3D卡通** | 赛璐珞着色应用于3D模型 | 可爱、现代、可接近的 | 儿童节目、广告 |

### 第2层：线条工作和轮廓

#### 线条风格定义

```
粗线条（3-5像素）→
- 外观：大胆、表现力强、儿童友好
- 使用场景：儿童节目、喜剧、可爱的角色
- 情绪：温暖、可接近、有趣

精细线条（1-2像素）→
- 外观：优雅、精致、工艺感
- 使用场景：艺术动画、长篇电影、复杂的角色
- 情绪：复杂、成熟、有意的

无轮廓（赛璐珞）→
- 外观：干净、现代、平坦
- 使用场景：品牌动画、3D卡通、极简主义
- 情绪：聚焦、现代、专业

可变线条（粗细变化）→
- 外观：艺术感、手绘、有机
- 使用场景：艺术电影、实验动画
- 情绪：创意、独特、手工制作
```

#### 轮廓色彩心理学

```
纯黑色 → 高对比度、高能量、戏剧性
深灰色（#333） → 柔和的轮廓、不那么严厉
棕色或焦土色 → 温暖、友好、复古
深蓝色 → 平静、优雅、夜间设置
```

### 第3层：调色板和色彩理论

#### 调色板策略

**高能量（儿童/喜剧）**
```
原色：红色、黄色、蓝色
附加颜色：绿色、紫色、橙色
饱和度：高（80-100%）
对比度：强烈
```

**温暖和舒适（故事讲述）**
```
主色：暖橙色、棕色、米色
辅助色：焦土色、金色、深红色
饱和度：中等（60-80%）
对比度：柔和
```

**冷和神秘**
```
主色：深蓝色、深紫色、青色
辅助色：薄荷绿、银色、淡紫色
饱和度：中等到高
对比度：对比强
```

**现代和极简**
```
主色：中立（灰色、白色、黑色）
口音：一个或两个非常明亮的颜色
饱和度：低到中等（除了口音）
对比度：精确和意图
```

#### 颜色心理学

```
红色 → 能量、紧急、激情。用于动作、重要时刻。
蓝色 → 冷静、信任、悲伤。用于深思熟虑的场景。
黄色 → 快乐、警告、友好。用于喜剧、日光。
绿色 → 自然、增长、毒性。用于环境或外星人设置。
紫色 → 魔法、神秘、皇家。用于幻想或高端场景。
橙色 → 温暖、友好、兴奋。用于日光和快乐的时刻。
灰色 → 中立、悲伤、未来派。用于城市或科幻设置。
```

### 第4层：动画风格和运动类型

#### 动画类型

| 类型 | 特征 | 运动感觉 | 用途 |
|------|------|--------|------|
| **完全动画（12fps）** | 每帧都绘制，平滑 | 液体、逼真的 | 电影、复杂动作 |
| **有限动画（8fps）** | 关键帧之间的跳跃 | 风格化、节奏化 | 电视动画、成本控制 |
| **单帧动画（4fps）** | 清晰的关键帧图像 | 卡通、卡通化 | 角色切换、演讲 |
| **运动图形** | 文本和形状移动 | 设计驱动、流畅 | 品牌、解释器、广告 |
| **停止运动** | 逐帧移动拍摄 | 物理、纹理、有机 | 超现实、特色、工艺感 |

#### 运动风格描述符

```
弹性运动 → 额外往返，超射。充满活力，可爱。
流体运动 → 长缓冲，弧形。优雅，逼真。
僵硬运动 → 快速关键帧转变。机械，卡通化。
漂浮运动 → 缓慢加速和减速。梦幻，空灵。
冲击运动 → 快速启动，立即停止。冲击，能量。
摇晃运动 → 小的高频抖动。紧张，焦虑。
```

### 第5层：背景和环境

#### 背景风格

```
极简背景 → 纯色或简单渐变。焦点在角色上。
线条背景 → 黑色线条定义形状。廉价，风格化。
分布式背景 → 速度线、动作背景、拉伸背景。日本动漫。
详细环境 → 完整绘制的背景。电影、工作室质量。
3D背景 → 实时3D与2D角色叠加。现代、混合。
数据可视化 → 网格、数字、代码雨。科技、未来派。
```

### 第6层：VFX和视觉效果

#### 动画VFX元素

```
速度线 → 运动指示、能量、动作感
拖尾 → 脱落的剪影显示运动弧
闪光 → 对特别重要的动作的强调
粒子 → 灰尘、星星、雪、光
形状变形 → 变形、拉伸、扭曲以显示力
光或发光 → 魔法、能量、重要时刻
对焦效果 → 模糊的背景，锐利的前景
```

---

## 完整提示词模板

### 标准卡通角色动画

```
[角色]: [名称/描述]。[风格]（例如迪士尼、日本动漫、扁平设计）
[外观]: [头发、眼睛、身体、服装描述]
[调色板]: 主色：[颜色]。次要颜色：[颜色]。口音：[颜色]。
[线条工作]: 线条粗细：[粗/细/可变]。轮廓颜色：[颜色]。
[背景]: [极简/分布式/环境]
[打光]: [简单的平面着色]或[柔和的阴影]
[动画风格]: [完全/有限/单帧]。运动：[弹性/流体/僵硬]
[动作]: [0–2秒动作描述]
[音频]: [配乐类型]或[语音同步]
[VFX]: [速度线]、[闪光]等
```

### 标准日本动漫风格

```
[场景]: [设置]。[时间]。
[角色]: [名称]。[年龄]。[个性]。大眼睛，长头发。赛璐珞着色。
[动画]: 有限动画（8fps）。闪光。分布式背景。表达变化爆炸式。
[颜色]: 高对比度。高饱和度。[主色]和[次色]。
[打光]: 高键。清晰的阴影区域。高对比度。
[背景]: 分布式或极简。速度线。
[声音]: 动漫配乐。可能的配音。
[动作]: [0–3秒动作，通常是关键帧式的]
```

### 标准扁平设计动画

```
[概念]: [描述]
[风格]: 扁平设计。几何形状。无轮廓。渐变。
[颜色]: 调色板：[5种颜色列表]。中等饱和度。
[类型]: 运动图形、品牌动画或故事讲述。
[形状]: 简单的几何或有机形状。平滑边缘。
[动画]: 平滑变换。形状变形。[1-2秒到位]
[背景]: 单色或简单渐变。
[音乐]: 现代、极简的配乐或上升音。
[文本]: [如果适用，无衬线字体、简洁消息]
[VFX]: 最少。可能的闪光或淡出。
```

### 标准儿童故事动画

```
[故事]: [叙述]
[角色]: [友好的、可爱的设计]。[和蔼的颜色]。
[动画]: 完全动画（12fps）。流体和富有表现力的运动。
[背景]: 详细和温暖的环境。配色精心选择。
[调色板]: 温暖颜色。中等到高饱和度。柔和的对比度。
[配音]: 友好的叙述声音。音乐。SFX（动物声音等）
[运动]: 弹性、可爱、友好的运动风格。
[VFX]: 闪光、粒子（星星、魔法）。柔软的过渡。
[节奏]: 缓慢到中等。清楚的故事弧。
```

---

## 高级优化

### 1. 同步到音乐或配乐

```
提示词片段：
"动画同步到音乐节拍。
击鼓 = 角色跳跃或重击
弦乐高潮 = 表达变化或特写
低音鼓 = 角色落地或冲击
```

### 2. 角色设计系统

对于系列或多角色项目：

```
主要角色：[高详细度，突出功能]
次要角色：[简化版本，可识别]
群众：[再次简化，一致的风格]

保持一致的：
- 线条粗细和风格
- 眼睛形状和大小
- 颜色关系
- 人体比例
```

### 3. 连续性和一致性

```
如果生成多个镜头：
- 保持相同的角色模型（使用@material参考）
- 保持相同的背景风格
- 保持相同的动画风格和帧率
- 保持相同的色彩分级
```

### 4. VFX强调时刻

```
高能量时刻：
- 速度线
- 闪光
- 增加的饱和度
- 更快的帧率（12fps升至24fps）
- 运动模糊

情感时刻：
- 过度曝光或淡化
- 放缓（6fps）
- 闪光或光芒
- 颜色饱和度下降（悲伤）
```

---

## 常见陷阱

| 问题 | 原因 | 解决方案 |
|------|------|---------|
| 看起来生硬 | 缺乏缓冲和弧形 | 添加"流体缓冲进出" |
| 调色板不一致 | 过多的随机颜色 | 选择3-5种互补色 |
| 没有能量感 | 运动太缓慢或太线性 | 使用弹性或冲击运动 |
| 背景分散注意力 | 背景和角色同等复杂 | 简化背景；降低对比度 |
| 看起来太3D | 光线和阴影过于逼真 | 使用平坦着色；移除复杂的阴影 |
| 无法识别的字符 | 风格不一致 | 保持线条粗细和眼睛风格一致 |

---

## 提示工程检查清单

- [ ] 动画风格是否清晰明确？（迪士尼、日本动漫、扁平等）
- [ ] 调色板是否有3-5种核心颜色？
- [ ] 是否指定了运动风格（弹性、流体、僵硬）？
- [ ] 线条工作（粗细、轮廓颜色）是否定义？
- [ ] 背景风格是否支持焦点？
- [ ] 第一2秒是否建立了美学？
- [ ] VFX是否增强而不是分散？
- [ ] 帧率是否与动画风格相配？

---

## 快速参考

### 5分钟卡通提示词

```
[友好的角色]。[迪士尼风格]。
大眼睛。温暖的颜色。圆润的线条。
弹性运动。快速跳跃。笑脸。
极简背景。平坦着色。
[0–2秒]充满能量的场景。
```

### 日本动漫快速参考

```
[角色]。大眼睛。赛璐珞着色。高对比度线条。
有限动画（8fps）。表达变化。闪光。
分布式背景。高饱和度。[颜色]主色。
动漫配乐。[0–3秒]动作或对话。
```

---

## 最后的建议

卡通和动画成功的关键是**风格一致性**和**清晰的设计决策**。最好的动画看起来每个元素都做了选择——没有什么是意外的。

使用这个框架建立您的视觉语言，然后坚持它。一致性比完美更重要。

祝您在Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）上创作出令人惊艳的动画！

# Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）时尚造型书技能

## Introduction: Fashion Video with Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）

Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） is the ultimate platform for generating stunning fashion and model video content. This skill teaches you how to craft compelling fashion video prompts that showcase clothing, style, and models with cinematic precision. Fashion videos thrive on movement, lighting, and rhythm—and Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） delivers all three with frame-perfect control.

Whether you're launching a collection, creating a lookbook, or building brand content, Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） renders fashion videos that stop scrollers and convert viewers into customers.

---

## Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Specifications

**Video Generation Engine:** Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）
**Optimal Duration:** 15 seconds (standard), up to 60 seconds for cinematic campaigns
**Native Resolution:** 1080p (16:9), 1080p (9:16) for mobile, 1440p available
**Frame Rate:** 24fps (cinematic), 30fps (crisp), 60fps (slow-motion)
**Motion Control:** Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） supports frame-by-frame choreography, camera movements, and dynamic transitions
**Aspect Ratios:** 16:9 (desktop/YouTube), 9:16 (TikTok/Reels/Stories), 1:1 (Instagram)
**Color Grading:** Built-in cinematography presets; supports custom LUTs and color correction
**Motion Clarity:** Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） excels at fluid garment motion, fabric drape, and model movement without motion blur artifacts

---

## The 2-Second Hook Framework for Fashion Videos

Every great fashion video captures attention in the first 2 seconds. Your opening shot is everything. Here are 10+ proven hooks that work on Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）:

### 1. Dramatic Outfit Reveal (Curtain/Door)
Model stands behind sheer curtain or walks through door. Curtain pulls back or door swings open. Outfit is fully revealed, camera holds for 0.5 seconds. Instant impact, full outfit visible. **Best for:** Haute couture, launch reveals, formal wear.

### 2. Model Power-Walk Directly at Camera
Model walks straight toward camera at moderate pace, confidence radiating. Camera slightly tilts down as they approach, dominates frame by second 1.5. Attitude and attitude-driven fashion. **Best for:** Streetwear, athleisure, bold campaigns.

### 3. Rapid Outfit Change Flash Cuts
Cut between 2–4 different outfit angles in 1 second. Each outfit appears for 0.3–0.5 seconds. Dizzying, exciting, showcases variety. **Best for:** Lookbooks, collections with multiple pieces, style guides.

### 4. Fabric Texture Extreme Macro
Camera starts extreme close-up on fabric—weave, sequins, leather texture visible. Slowly pulls back to reveal model wearing the piece. Tactile, aspirational. **Best for:** Luxury materials, sustainable fabrics, fabric-forward campaigns.

### 5. Slow-Motion Hair and Fabric Wind
Model stationary or walking. Hair and fabric billow in slow-motion wind (real or CG). Sensual, dramatic, fashion-film energy. **Best for:** Evening wear, formal wear, luxury brands.

### 6. Mirror or Reflection Reveal
Model's reflection appears in a mirror, window, or reflective surface before full body is seen. Turn, tilt, or approach reveals outfit. Elegant, editorial. **Best for:** Formal wear, accessories, beauty-integrated campaigns.

### 7. Color-Coordinated Environment Match
Model outfit matches or complements background (blue outfit on blue wall, green dress in garden). Monochromatic harmony draws eye to silhouette. **Best for:** Minimalist fashion, editorial, mood-driven content.

### 8. Accessory Close-Up to Full Look
Open on detailed shot of shoes, bag, or jewelry. Camera pulls back to show full model and outfit. Accessory stars first, then context. **Best for:** Accessory-focused campaigns, luxury details, jewelry.

### 9. Silhouette Shadow Spin
Model's shadow on wall or ground. Silhouette spins, moves, reveals outfit shape. Real model enters frame. Mysterious, playful, modern. **Best for:** Contemporary fashion, streetwear, trendy brands.

### 10. Elevator or Descent Reveal
Model descends stairs, steps out of elevator, or walks down ramp. Camera frames from front or side. Movement conveys confidence, outfit reveals progressively. **Best for:** Luxury, formal wear, power fashion.

### 11. Zoom or Scale Shift
Camera rapidly zooms from wide shot (full outfit/environment) to medium (torso/face). Or vice versa. Creates energy, emphasizes key pieces. **Best for:** Detail-oriented lookbooks, accessory showcases, multi-piece collections.

### 12. Rotation Spin (360° or Partial)
Model rotates slowly (360°) or spins (180°–270°). Camera circles or stays static. Showcases outfit from all angles. **Best for:** Fit showcases, tailoring-focused campaigns, collection pieces.

---

## Fashion Video Philosophy: What Sells Clothes

### Movement Sells Clothes
Clothing looks alive when the model moves. A stationary pose is lifeless; a walk, sway, or gesture transforms a simple outfit into a story. Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） excels at rendering natural motion that makes fabrics flow and pieces breathe.

### Fabric in Motion
Silk ripples. Denim has weight and structure. Chiffon floats. Leather creases distinctly. Your prompt must describe how the fabric should move. "Silk blouse catches light and gently ripples" creates desire; "static blouse" does not.

### Lighting Flatters the Wearer
Fashion lives and dies by light. Golden hour is universally flattering. Studio flash creates editorial crispness. Neon creates edge. Shadows create drama. Always specify your lighting because it changes how the garment reads on camera.

### Environment as Mood
A white minimalist studio says luxury and minimalism. A gritty urban street says streetwear and rebellion. A lush garden says romantic and aspirational. The environment isn't background—it's context that sells the aesthetic.

### The Model as Character
A model with confidence, attitude, or personality sells clothes better than a blank stare. Direct the model's energy, emotions, and attitude. "Confident strut" vs. "uncertain walk" fundamentally changes how viewers perceive the outfit.

### Rhythm of Outfit Changes
If showcasing multiple looks, rhythm matters. Fast cuts create energy. Slow transitions create luxury and intentionality. A 15-second lookbook should flow like music: intro, build, climax, resolution.

### Balance Aspiration with Relatability
Haute couture aspires; everyday wear relates. A fashion campaign should inspire viewers to imagine themselves in the outfit. Too distant feels unattainable; too casual feels cheap. Find the sweet spot.

---

## Master Template for Fashion Video Prompts

Use this structure to craft every fashion video prompt for Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）:

```
PROMPT STRUCTURE:

[VIDEO DURATION & ASPECT RATIO]
Duration: 15 seconds | Aspect: 16:9 (or 9:16 for mobile)

[2-SECOND HOOK]
Opening 0–2 seconds: [Specific hook type] – [What appears on screen]

[OUTFIT DESCRIPTION]
Garment: [Piece name, color, fabric, fit details]
Styling: [Accessories, shoes, hair, makeup, overall vibe]
Fit details: [Silhouette, how it drapes, key visual features]

[MODEL DIRECTION]
Walk/Pose: [Confident strut, slow sway, playful spin, etc.]
Attitude: [Confidence, sensuality, approachability, attitude, playfulness, etc.]
Expression: [Subtle smile, strong gaze, relaxed, contemplative, etc.]

[ENVIRONMENT & LIGHTING]
Location: [Studio, street, nature, interior, etc.]
Lighting: [Golden hour, studio flash, neon, dramatic, natural, etc.]
Background: [Color, texture, relevance to outfit]
Props: [Optional: mirrors, frames, doors, etc.]

[MOTION SEQUENCE]

## Model Direction Keywords: Poses, Walks, Expressions, and Attitude

### Walk Types
- **Power walk:** Confident, direct stride toward camera, shoulders back, purposeful.
- **Slow sway:** Gentle side-to-side movement, fluid, relaxed, sensual.
- **Strut:** Attitude-forward walk with swagger, exaggerated confidence, head high.
- **Catwalk/runway:** Straight line, deliberate heel-to-toe placement, poised, dramatic.
- **Casual amble:** Relaxed walk, natural gait, approachable, everyday.
- **Float/glide:** Ethereal, effortless movement, minimal effort visible.
- **Stomp/bold stride:** Heavy, confident footfalls, strong presence, attitude.

### Pose Types
- **Standing profile:** Side angle showcases silhouette and drape.
- **Three-quarter turn:** Partial rotation shows front and side simultaneously.
- **Hands on hips:** Confident, powerful, statement-making.
- **Hands in pockets:** Casual, approachable, relaxed.
- **Over-shoulder glance:** Confident, mysterious, editorial.
- **Full rotation/spin:** Showcases all angles, playful, dynamic.
- **Lean or recline:** Relaxed, sensual, editorial, languid.

### Expression Types
- **Strong gaze:** Direct eye contact, confidence, intensity.
- **Subtle smile:** Approachable, warm, friendly, relatable.
- **Smoldering look:** Sensual, confident, editorial, attitude.
- **Blank slate:** High-fashion, editorial, lets outfit speak.
- **Genuine laugh:** Authentic joy, playful, relatability.
- **Contemplative gaze:** Thoughtful, editorial, moody.
- **Attitude/side-eye:** Attitude-forward, streetwear, rebellious energy.

### Attitude Keywords
- **Confidence:** Assured, powerful, commanding presence.
- **Sensuality:** Graceful, fluid, alluring, subtly seductive.
- **Playfulness:** Joyful, light, fun, approachable.
- **Attitude:** Bold, rebellious, unapologetic, edge.
- **Grace:** Elegant, refined, poised, understated.
- **Approachability:** Relatable, friendly, warm, accessible.
- **Edginess:** Modern, dark, moody, alternative.
- **Rebelliousness:** Anti-establishment, rule-breaking, fearless.

### Hand & Arm Gestures
- **Arms relaxed at sides:** Natural, neutral, balanced.
- **Hands through hair:** Sensual, editorial, playful.
- **Adjusting garment:** Interactive, engaged, grounded.
- **Pointing or gesturing:** Commanding, attention-drawing, interactive.
- **Crossed arms:** Attitude, confidence, or barrier.
- **Arms overhead:** Celebratory, free, powerful, joyful.
- **Hand on chest or heart:** Genuine, emotional, authentic.

## Fabric & Material Showcase: How to Highlight Different Fabrics

### Silk & Satin
**Visual Properties:** Lustrous, reflective, drapes gracefully, catches light beautifully.
**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt:** "Silk fabric catches light and shimmers with each movement. Gentle wind or walk causes fabric to flow smoothly without clinging. Ripples and folds create subtle light reflections."
**Best Movement:** Slow walks, gentle sways, wind effects (real or CG), flowing transitions.
**Lighting:** Directional light that highlights sheen; golden hour or studio flash.

### Denim & Cotton
**Visual Properties:** Textured, matte, structured, fades with wear, shows creases and folds.
**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt:** "Denim shows natural wrinkles and creases as model walks. Fabric has weight and structure, not clinging. Worn patches or fade details visible. Sturdy, reliable texture."
**Best Movement:** Natural walks, dynamic movement, sits and stands to show how fabric creases.
**Lighting:** Natural daylight, bright and even, showing texture.

### Leather & Suede
**Visual Properties:** Smooth and glossy (leather) or soft and matte (suede), creases distinctly, shows wear and movement clearly.
**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt:** "Leather jacket moves with the body, creasing naturally at elbows and waist. Glossy sheen catches light as model walks. Suede has soft, matte finish that shows subtle creasing."
**Best Movement:** Confident walks, arm movements to show jacket drape, quick movements to show crease.
**Lighting:** Studio flash or bright light highlighting surface; creates defined shadows.

### Chiffon & Lightweight Fabrics
**Visual Properties:** Flowing, delicate, catches air easily, ethereal, floats rather than clings.
**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt:** "Chiffon flows and floats around the body. Even subtle air movement causes fabric to billow gently. Layers drape softly without any stiffness. Translucent quality allows light through."
**Best Movement:** Slow walks, swaying movements, wind effects, spins to show flowing action.
**Lighting:** Backlight or sidelighting to show translucence; soft diffused light.

### Knit & Sweater Fabric
**Visual Properties:** Textured, warm, stretches and clings slightly to body, shows ribbing and weave detail.
**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt:** "Knit sweater hugs the body subtly, showing natural fabric texture. Ribbing and weave detail visible in close-up. Fabric stretches naturally with movement. Cozy, tactile appearance."
**Best Movement:** Natural walks, arm movements showing stretch, comfortable poses.
**Lighting:** Close-up shots showing texture; warm, flattering light.

### Velvet & Crushed Fabrics
**Visual Properties:** Luxurious, color-shifting with nap direction, soft appearance, dramatic light play.
**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt:** "Velvet shows color depth and subtle sheen as model moves. Nap direction creates shifting highlights as body moves. Ultra-soft, luxurious appearance. Light plays across surface creating depth."
**Best Movement:** Rotations and turns to show light play, sensual slow movements.

### Sequins & Beaded Fabric
**Visual Properties:** Reflective, glittery, catches and throws light, sparkles with movement, eye-catching.

## Outfit Change Transitions: Creative Ways to Shift Between Looks

### Flash Cut / Quick Cut
**How it works:** Instant cut between two outfit angles. Each shot lasts 0.3–0.5 seconds.
**Best for:** Multi-look lookbooks, rapid style showcase, energetic content.
**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt:** "Quick cut transition between Outfit A and Outfit B. No transition effect. Instant shift. Energetic, exciting pace. Dizzying variety of looks."

### Spin Transition
**How it works:** Model spins on camera. During spin, outfit changes. Model stops in new outfit.
**Best for:** Playful campaigns, multi-look showcases, fun energy.
**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt:** "Model spins clockwise. Mid-spin, outfit changes (seamless). Model stops facing camera in new outfit. Playful, dynamic transition."

### Door / Curtain Walk-Through
**How it works:** Model approaches and walks through door or curtain. Emerges on other side in new outfit.
**Best for:** Reveal moments, fresh look introduction, elegant transitions.
**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt:** "Model walks toward curtain. Pushes through. Emerges on other side in new outfit. Curtain closes behind. Elegant, reveal-based transition."

### Curtain / Blind Reveal
**How it works:** Curtain or blind closes over first outfit. Opens to reveal new outfit.
**Best for:** Dramatic transitions, high-fashion moments, luxury feels.
**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt:** "Sheer curtain or fabric swings across frame, momentarily obscuring model. Curtain swings away. New outfit revealed. Dramatic, elegant transition."

### Mirror Transition
**How it works:** Model's reflection changes in mirror. Model steps away or camera pans to reveal change.
**Best for:** Reflective moments, elegant transitions, editorial vibes.
**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt:** "Model's reflection visible in mirror. Reflection changes outfits while model is obscured. Camera pans or reflects back to model in new outfit. Elegant, slightly surreal transition."

### Shadow Silhouette Transition
**How it works:** Model's shadow on wall or ground shifts. Real model enters frame in new outfit.
**Best for:** Artistic transitions, contemporary campaigns, playful reveals.
**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt:** "Model's shadow on wall moves and changes pose. Shadow appears to change outfit color or silhouette. Real model steps into frame in new outfit. Playful, artistic transition."

### Zoom In / Out Transition
**How it works:** Camera rapidly zooms in on detail (fabric, shoe, accessory). Pulls back to reveal full new outfit.
**Best for:** Detail-focused transitions, accessory showcases, emphasis shifts.
**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt:** "Camera zooms rapidly to extreme close-up of Outfit A detail. Pulls back quickly. Frame reveals Outfit B. Dynamic, emphasizes new detail."

### Fade or Dissolve
**How it works:** First outfit gradually fades to black or transparent. Second outfit fades in.
**Best for:** Elegant transitions, formal wear, polished lookbooks.
**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt:** "Outfit A gradually fades to transparent, then fades to black. Simultaneously, Outfit B fades in from black. Smooth dissolve transition. Polished, elegant."

### Ascend/Descend or Vertical Movement
**How it works:** Model rises or descends out of frame (elevator, stairs, platform). Returns in new outfit.
**Best for:** Luxury campaigns, dramatic reveals, high-fashion moments.
**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt:** "Model descends staircase in Outfit A. Exits bottom of frame. Re-enters top of frame descending in Outfit B. Vertical transition feels luxe and dramatic."

### Light Shift / Color Grade Change
**How it works:** Lighting or color temperature shifts. During shift, outfit changes. New light reveals new outfit.
**Best for:** Mood-driven transitions, contemporary campaigns, artistic looks.
**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt:** "Lighting shifts from warm to cool tone. Color temperature change masks transition. Outfit changes during lighting shift. New outfit revealed in new lighting. Artistic, moodful transition."

### Runway Walk Off / On
**How it works:** Model walks off-stage in one outfit. Another model (or same model, re-positioned) walks on-stage in new outfit.
**Best for:** Runway-inspired content, collection showcases, fashion show vibes.
**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt:** "Model walks down runway in Outfit A, exits stage right. New model (or repositioned) enters stage left in Outfit B. Runway show energy. Sequential walk transition."

### Overlay / Double Exposure
**How it works:** New outfit is briefly overlaid or double-exposed with previous outfit. Clears to show new outfit alone.
**Best for:** Artistic campaigns, contemporary looks, dreamy aesthetics.
**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt:** "Outfit A visible, then Outfit B appears as semi-transparent overlay. Overlaid moment lasts 0.5 seconds. Outfit A fades. Outfit B remains. Artistic, dreamy transition."

## Multi-Look Efficiency: Showcasing 5+ Outfits in 15 Seconds

When you need to pack multiple outfits into a short 15-second video, **pacing and transitions are critical.**

### The Fast-Paced Lookbook Structure:
- **Seconds 0–2:** 2-second hook (dramatic, stopping power)
- **Seconds 2–7:** Outfit 1 (walk, turn, 1–2 key angles)
- **Seconds 7–10:** Flash cut transition to Outfit 2
- **Seconds 10–12:** Outfit 2 (quick showcase, minimal)
- **Seconds 12–14:** Flash cut transition to Outfit 3
- **Seconds 14–15:** Final pose in Outfit 3 or ensemble shot

### Transition Tactics for Speed:
1. **Flash Cuts:** 0.3–0.5 seconds per outfit. Instant, no transition effect.
2. **Spin Transitions:** Model spins off-camera, re-enters in new outfit. Masks change seamlessly.
3. **Rapid Zoom Cuts:** Zoom in on detail (shoe, bag) of Outfit 1. Zoom out to reveal Outfit 2. Fast, dynamic.
4. **Light Shifts:** Lighting changes during transition, covering outfit swap with color temperature shift.
5. **Environment Change Cuts:** Model in studio for Outfit 1, cuts to outdoor for Outfit 2. Environmental change masks outfit change.

### Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt Structure for Multi-Look Video:
```
MULTI-LOOK EFFICIENCY PROMPT:

Duration: 15 seconds | Aspect: 9:16 (mobile)

HOOK (0–2s):
[Dramatic opening showcasing Outfit 1 in detail]

OUTFIT 1 (2–7s):
[Garment description]
[Model walks/poses]
[Key angles: front, side, back]

TRANSITION 1 (7–8s):
Flash cut OR spin transition OR zoom cut

OUTFIT 2 (8–11s):
[Garment description]
[Quick walk/pose]
[2 angles maximum]

TRANSITION 2 (11–12s):
Flash cut OR light shift

OUTFIT 3 (12–15s):
[Final, signature look]
[Confident final pose]

MOTION PACE:
- Fast cuts, no lingering
- Each outfit shows 2–3 angles max
- Transitions are instant
- Model energy is HIGH throughout
- No static moments

MUSIC PACE:
Fast, energetic music (120+ BPM). Beats align with cuts and transitions.
```

### Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Best Practices for Speed:
- **Camera cuts every 3–5 seconds** to maintain energy.
- **Model is never static** for more than 2 seconds.
- **Transitions mask outfit changes** completely.
- **Music drives pacing**; beats align with visual cuts.
- **Hook grabs attention immediately**; remaining 13 seconds prove variety.
- **Each outfit's silhouette should be distinctly different** for maximum visual variety in minimum time.

## Common Mistakes & Fixes

### Mistake 1: Static Model, Boring Outfit
**Problem:** Model stands still, facing camera. Outfit doesn't move. No sense of how garment wears in real life.
**Fix:** Add deliberate movement—walk, sway, turn, gesture. Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） excels at rendering motion. Show how fabric moves, how garment drapes on a living, breathing person.

**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt Fix:** "Model walks confidently toward camera, showcasing how fabric flows with movement. Each step causes dress to sway and settle naturally. By 1.5s, model is close enough for detail visibility, then turns to show side silhouette."

---

### Mistake 2: Unclear Garment Details
**Problem:** Outfit is described generically. Fit, fabrication, and styling details are vague. Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） renders what you prompt; vague input = vague output.
**Fix:** Be hyperspecific. Describe color name, fabric type, fit details (how it sits at waist, how it drapes). Describe exactly how it's styled (accessories, shoes, hair, makeup).

**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt Fix:**
- Instead of: "Black dress"
- Write: "Midi slip dress in deep black silk charmeuse. Fitted through bodice, loose and flowing from hip. Spaghetti straps, low scoop back. Worn with camel-tone cardigan draped over shoulders, burgundy pointed-toe heels, minimal jewelry."

---

### Mistake 3: Lighting Doesn't Flatter Garment
**Problem:** Generic "studio lighting" is vague. Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） can render any lighting style, but you must specify how light interacts with fabric, color, and silhouette.
**Fix:** Specify lighting direction, quality (hard vs. soft), and intention. How should light reveal garment beauty?

**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt Fix:**
- Instead of: "Lit by studio lights"
- Write: "Golden-hour sidelighting that casts warm glow across face and body. Backlighting creates rim light defining edges of flowing chiffon. Shadows are warm and flattering, no harsh contrast on face. Fabric sheen is emphasized by 45-degree key light."

---

### Mistake 4: Hook Isn't Compelling
**Problem:** Video opening doesn't stop viewers. Viewers scroll past before outfit is revealed.
**Fix:** Use proven hooks: dramatic reveals, close-ups of detail, surprising angle, motion that grabs attention.

**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt Fix:**
- Instead of: "Model walks toward camera"
- Write: "Extreme close-up of intricate beaded bodice (macro shot, light glinting off beads). Camera pulls back rapidly over 1 second, revealing model in full haute couture gown. By 2-second mark, silhouette is complete, pulling viewer from detail to grand reveal."

---

### Mistake 5: Outfit Doesn't Match Brand Aesthetic
**Problem:** Prompt includes details that feel off-brand or incoherent. Styling is generic, not specific to brand identity.
**Fix:** Ensure every detail (color, fit, styling, accessories) aligns with brand identity. Be intentional about aesthetic coherence.

**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt Fix:**
- Clarify brand vibe in prompt: "This outfit exemplifies [Brand Name]'s aesthetic: minimalist silhouettes, premium natural fabrics, understated luxury. Styling is intentionally spare; no logo-heavy accessories. Every piece is investment-quality, built to last."

---

### Mistake 6: Model Direction Is Vague
**Problem:** "Model looks confident" is subjective. Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） interprets vague direction inconsistently.
**Fix:** Use specific model direction keywords: confident strut, slow sway, playful spin, introspective gaze, strong eye contact, etc.

**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt Fix:**
- Instead of: "Model looks good"
- Write: "Model power-walks toward camera with strong stride. Shoulders back, head high. Direct eye contact with camera. Expression is confident and self-assured, slightly smirking. Each step is deliberate and grounded."

---

### Mistake 7: Too Many Outfits, Not Enough Time
**Problem:** Trying to fit 5 outfits into 10 seconds. Each outfit is rushed, unclear, and feels overwhelming.
**Fix:** Either extend video duration or reduce outfit count. Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） renders best when each outfit has 3–5 seconds minimum to establish clarity.

**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt Fix:**
- Instead of: "15-second video with 8 outfits"
- Write: "30-second video with 4 signature outfits. Each outfit showcases 6–7 seconds. Flash-cut transitions mask outfit changes. Pacing is energetic but clear."

---

### Mistake 8: Weak Transitions
**Problem:** Transitions between outfits are jarring or unclear. Change mechanics are visible or awkward.
**Fix:** Use seamless transition techniques: spin masks, light shifts, environment changes, zoom transitions, flash cuts.

**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt Fix:**
- Instead of: "Change to next outfit"
- Write: "Model spins clockwise at center frame. During spin, outfit changes seamlessly (mid-rotation, masked by spinning motion). Model completes spin and stops in new outfit, facing camera."

---

### Mistake 9: Accessories Are Ignored
**Problem:** Model and outfit are featured, but styling details (jewelry, shoes, belt, bag) are unclear or lost in frame.
**Fix:** Deliberately highlight accessories. Use close-ups, specific camera angles, and deliberate movement to showcase accessories.

**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt Fix:**
- Include: "Camera cuts to close-up of shoes (luxury leather detail visible). Model's hands adjust necklace (jewelry highlighted). Hand touches bag strap (craftsmanship visible). Accessories are as much the story as the outfit."

---

### Mistake 10: No Clear Call to Action
**Problem:** Video ends with no direction. Viewers don't know where to shop or how to engage with brand.
**Fix:** Include clear, integrated CTA. Text overlay with website, "Shop Now" link, or collection name.

**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt Fix:**
- Add: "During final 2 seconds, text overlay appears (integrated naturally, not jarring): '[Brand Name] Spring Collection 2026' | 'Shop the Look' | Link to collection page. Text is elegant, matches brand typography."

---

## Platform Optimization: Tailoring Videos for Different Channels

### Instagram Feed (16:9, 1080x1080)
**Optimization:**
- Focus on still-frame freeze moments that work as static images.
- Colors must be saturated for Instagram algorithm success.
- Hook must capture attention in first 0.5s (auto-play, often muted).
- Text overlay is critical (no sound guarantee).
- Outfit should be recognizable in thumbnail.

**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt Addition:**
"Video optimized for Instagram Feed. Opening 0.5 seconds is visually stunning and works as static image for post thumbnail. Colors are vibrant and Instagram-algorithm-friendly (reds, golds, jewel tones pop; pastels may be undersaturated). Include text overlay (brand name, hashtag, or CTA) during key moments. Video is captivating even without sound."

### Instagram Reels (9:16, 1080x1920)
**Optimization:**
- Vertical format optimized for phone viewing.
- Music is integral (Reels are music-first platform).
- Fast cuts, quick pacing, trending audio.
- Text overlays guide viewers through narrative.
- First 1 second must stop the scroll.

**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt Addition:**
"Video optimized for Instagram Reels (vertical 9:16 format). Motion and cuts are rapid, matching trending audio. Text overlays guide narrative ('New Collection,' 'Out Now,' etc.). First 1 second is stopping power (dramatic reveal, fast motion, or surprising angle). Audio is trending and recognizable (viewers feel they're part of trend). Entire video is optimized for phone viewing (legible text, portrait framing)."

### TikTok (9:16, 1080x1920)
**Optimization:**
- Similar to Reels but with even faster pacing expectations.
- Trending sounds are essential (TikTok algorithm heavily favors trending audio).
- Hashtags and text are navigational (viewers search by hashtag).
- Authenticity and relatability are valued over polish (though fashion content should be aspirational).
- Niche fashion communities are strong on TikTok (cottagecore, dark academia, e-girl fashion, etc.).

**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt Addition:**
"Video optimized for TikTok. Pacing is fast, cuts are quick, trending audio is essential. Text overlays include hashtags (#FashionHaul #OutfitOfTheDay #LookbookStyle). Vibe is aspirational but relatable (not overly polished; authenticity is valued). If niche fashion aesthetic (e.g., cottagecore, streetwear, Y2K), lean into aesthetic heavily. First 0.3 seconds must stop the scroll; second 0.3 seconds must make viewers want to watch to the end."

### YouTube (16:9, 1920x1080)
**Optimization:**
- Longer-form content is viable (30–60 second videos).
- Narrative and storytelling are valued.
- Thumbnails are critical (still frame must be compelling).
- SEO and title/description matter (searchability).
- Audience retention is measured (so pacing should maintain engagement throughout).

**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt Addition:**
"Video optimized for YouTube. Duration can be 30–60 seconds, allowing for narrative development and multiple outfit showcases. Opening frame is compelling as standalone thumbnail. Pacing maintains engagement throughout (no static 10-second holds that lose viewers). Title: '[Brand Name] 2026 Lookbook | Sustainable Fashion' (keyword-optimized). Description includes SEO-friendly keywords, website link, and brand story. Narrative flows from introduction (collection theme) through outfit progression to finale (brand message)."

### Pinterest (various, 1000x1500 is popular)
**Optimization:**
- Vertical or square format is preferred (pins are vertical).
- Fashion inspiration and styling tips perform well.
- Link to full blog post or product page is essential (Pinterest is traffic driver).
- Text overlay and graphic elements (title, CTA) are important.
- Aesthetic consistency across multiple pins is valued.

**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt Addition:**
"Video optimized for Pinterest. Format is square or vertical (1000x1500 or 1080x1350). Content is inspiring and aspirational (styling tips, outfit combinations, fashion ideas). Text overlay includes title ('10 Ways to Style White Sneakers') and CTA ('Click to Shop'). Visual is optimized as static pin thumbnail (if paused at any frame, it should be compelling). Brand watermark is subtle but visible, reinforcing brand identity across platform."

### Fashion Website / Blog
**Optimization:**
- High resolution and cinematic quality are expected.
- Long-form content (30–60 seconds) is acceptable and even preferred.
- Music and audio should enhance story without overpowering voiceover (if voiceover is used).
- Storytelling and brand narrative are central.
- Loading speed is important (optimize video compression without quality loss).

**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield） Prompt Addition:**
"Video optimized for brand website. High production quality and cinematic aesthetic expected. Duration: 30–45 seconds, allowing for complete storytelling. Music enhances narrative without overpowering. If voiceover is present, video supports voiceover (video doesn't need to stand alone). Narrative arc from problem/inspiration through outfit presentation to brand message/CTA. Video positioned prominently on homepage or collection page to emphasize brand values and aesthetic."

# Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）动漫风格视频生成

## 理解动漫作为视觉媒介

动漫并非简单的"卡通动画"。它是具有独特视觉语言、美学原理和故事叙述惯例的精致的日本动画传统，这些已经演变了数十年。生成真正的动漫风格视频需要理解动漫如何通过深思熟虑的艺术选择而不是意外来达到其标志性外观。

动漫使用**有限动画和影响帧**——而不是平滑的24fps运动，关键帧被战略性地放置在最重要的地方，创造了动态视觉节奏。帧之间的间隙不是懒惰；它们是有意的。这种技术与戏剧性光照、色彩心理学和深思熟虑的沉默相结合，创造了在西方动画中不可能实现的情感强度。

Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）使我们能够将这些原理编码到视频提示中，以捕捉真正的动漫美学——从角色设计的单色着色的平坦度到动作序列的爆炸性能量。

---

## Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）规格

**平台：** Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）
**视频格式：** MP4、WebM、ProRes
**分辨率：** 1080p（1920x1080）或4K（3840x2160）
**帧率：** 24fps（动漫标准）或60fps（高动作慢动作）
**时长：** 最优2-30秒；最多60秒可能
**宽高比：** 16:9（电影院）、9:16（移动设备）、1:1（方形）
**颜色空间：** Rec. 709（标准）或DCI-P3（分级）

**Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）动漫的关键功能：**
- **单色着色模拟：** 创建2D渲染的外观
- **运动模糊控制：** 精确控制帧插值
- **影响帧冻结：** 保持关键时刻以获得戏剧性效果
- **色彩分级：** 实现动漫特征的颜色调色板
- **粒子效果：** 速度线、火花、光环、樱花瓣
- **角色变形：** 面部表情、迷你人物反应、情感扭曲
- **摄像头运动：** 动态缩放、旋转镜头、荷兰倾斜
- **光效：** 边缘光照、戏剧性阴影、光线因果关系

---

## 动漫的2秒钩子框架

动漫剪辑的最初2秒必须立即建立动漫美学并通过视觉冲击来吸引注意力。这10多个动漫钩子应该融入开场时刻：

### 1. **带光反射的戏剧性眼睛特写**
眼睛是动漫的灵魂。以角色眼睛的极度特写开场，当光线反射过来时，显示情感或力量觉醒。虹膜应显示细节——星形高光、颜色渐变或火焰/动作的微小反射。0.5秒的静止，然后瞳孔收缩或扩张，因为场景"激活"。

### 2. **速度线爆发**
标志性的动漫视觉。直线（透视线）从框架中心或对象发出，表示突然的运动或即将发生的时刻。线条可以是水平的、径向的或跟随扫动运动的边缘。与轻微的放大或对象进入相结合。

### 3. **变身序列闪光**
如果适用：白光闪现遮挡屏幕，然后拉回显示变身状态——新服装、升能形式或角色转变。闪光应该是瞬间的和令人困惑的，最多持续0.3秒。

### 4. **刀鞘拔出带金属闪烁**
用金属光泽拔出剑、武器或物体。当刀刃从鞘中清除时，灿烂的光反射闪过它。配对带尖锐的声音（隐含）和轻微的运动放慢。

### 5. **升能光环爆炸**
从角色周围向外扩展：发光能量（电蓝色、金色或紫色）按层向外散射，粒子追踪。膨胀应该向外推进有力，暂时扭曲背景。光环颜色决定力量类型（冷=冰、温暖=火等）。

### 6. **樱花风阵**
花瓣在风阵中穿过框架，建立"动漫浪漫"或"怀旧"心情。花瓣应该是半透明的，漂浮在看不见的气流上，可能遮挡/显示后面的元素。适合和平的场景或情感时刻。

### 7. **动漫标题卡砸击**
大胆的、风格化的文本（片假名、汉字或英语）以动态透视出现，从屏幕外旋转到位。背景可能会移动或模糊。文本应该有大胆的轮廓和填充，与动漫OP/ED标题处理相匹配。

### 8. **对比剧烈天空的角色剪影**
对比金色日落、蓝色暮光或风暴云的角色或物体的剪影。天空填充60-70%的框架，具有戏剧性的颜色渐变。剪影是完全黑色的。建立语调和规模。

### 9. **带十字形高光的影响帧**
物理撞击的时刻——拳击、刀剑打击或碰撞——冻结在时间中，中心有明亮的十字形高光。周围区域可能模糊或向后运动模糊。持续0.2-0.4秒。

### 10. **迷你人物反应弹出**
对于更轻松的动漫：角色突然出现在夸张的"迷你"比例（更大的头、更小的身体），具有特大的表情——惊讶、愤怒或可爱。伴随着卡通声音（隐含）和快速的脉动发光。

### 11. **汗水滴反应**
单个汗珠出现在角色的脸/头上，反射光线并下落——暗示紧张、努力或喜剧。水滴应该有光泽并逼真地捕捉光线。

### 12. **屏幕色调转变**
整个图像暂时叠加带有网纹图案或对角线（让人想起漫画），强调情感或喜剧时刻。在清除前持续0.1-0.3秒。

---

## 动漫美学哲学

要编写有效的动漫提示，请理解这些视觉原理：

### **单色着色和平坦性**
动漫角色在2D平面上绘制。背景通常用水彩般的纹理绘制。光应该显示形式而不是照片现实——阴影是实心颜色块，而不是渐变。头发和衣服有定义的边缘，而不是羽毛混合。

### **有限动画带战略性影响**
并非每一帧都动画。角色保持姿态0.5-1秒。当运动发生时，它是决定性的和大胆的——拳击在0.2秒内完全传播。静态帧存在于运动序列之间，创造视觉节奏并允许观众的眼睛"读取"动作。

### **戏剧性光照**
动漫使用光线来创建情绪和引导情感：
- **边缘光照：** 角色轮廓周围的亮轮廓（通常是金色、青色或白色）
- **方向光：** 单或双光源创建强阴影
- **欠照脸部：** 来自下方的光建议危险或神秘
- **背光：** 剪影、光晕和发光效果很常见

### **速度线（条纹）**
运动不是通过模糊显示的。相反，直线（从消失点的透视线）表示方向和速度。速度线是尖锐的，不是柔和的。它们出现在移动物体后面或在快速摄像机运动期间填充屏幕。

### **色彩心理学**
动漫颜色从不是偶然的：
- **温暖的饱和颜色：** 动作、激情、能量（红色、金色、橙色）
- **冷色的去饱和颜色：** 忧郁、神秘、内省（蓝色、紫色、灰色）
- **高对比饱和度：** 动态场景，带有大胆的原色
- **粉彩或柔和色调：** 日常生活、怀旧、和平时刻

### **眼睛设计**
眼睛不成比例地大且详细：
- 多层高光（星星、十字形、反射）
- 虹膜颜色不现实（紫色、金色、绿色、红色）
- 瞳孔为情感收缩/扩张
- 睫毛呈角形，不是柔和的
- 眼白通常反射微小的图像（其他角色、风景）

### **头发物理**
头发行为不可能——它漂浮、尖刺或流动着不存在的风。头发股是定义和个体的。在运动期间，头发条纹或尾迹（运动模糊但有轮廓）。重力是可选的。

### **屏幕色调和图案**
网点、对角线和网格图案覆盖场景以建议纹理、情感或喜剧效果。这些是从漫画借来的，但被翻译为运动图像。

---

## 动漫视频提示的主模板

将此结构用作所有动漫风格 Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）提示的基线：

```
[视觉风格]
使用Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）生成动漫风格视频。美学：[少年漫画/青年漫画/魔法少女/机甲/等]。
艺术风格：单色着色的2D动漫。有限的动画，带关键影响帧。[颜色调色板描述]。

[开场2秒]
钩子：[从2秒钩子框架中选择]。
[描述确切的视觉：位置、时间、颜色、效果]

[主场景1 - 第2-8秒]
设置：[地点、一天中的时间、气氛的详细描述]
角色动作：[发生什么]
动画风格：[运动类型：快速/缓慢、影响帧、有限动画细节]
光照：[主光线方向、情绪光、特殊效果]
颜色：[主调色板、强调颜色]

[主场景2 - 第8-15秒]（如需要）
[重复上面的结构]

[音频/气氛]
声音设计：[管弦乐刺、沉默、日本摇滚、环境嗡鸣等]
节奏：[节拍时间、戏剧性暂停]
```

---

## 特定动漫子类型指南

### 少年漫画（战斗/冒险）

**关键视觉元素：**

## 常见动漫视觉错误与修复

| 错误 | 为什么有害 | Seedance 2.0修复 |

| 过度平滑的运动 | 看起来不像动漫 | 使用有限动画：关键帧然后暂停 |
| 色彩不足 | 无聊，无法传达心情 | 使用高对比度的颜色，不要害怕饱和度 |
| 没有速度线 | 失去动漫本质 | 添加速度线作为任何快速运动的效果 |
| 过度细节 | 与动漫的平坦美学冲突 | 简化。动漫是关于暗示而不是显示 |
| 眼睛太小 | 不像动漫 | 使眼睛大约占脸部的1/3。添加高光。 |
| 没有影响帧 | 缺少戏剧性 | 在每次重大撞击、转折或启示处冻结关键时刻 |

## 高级技巧：让您的动漫在Seedance 2.0上脱颖而出

### 1. **使用屏幕色调建议情感**
在安静的时刻添加轻微的网纹或对角线叠加。这是一个深层的动漫视觉线索。

### 2. **冻结关键时刻**
不要让每个运动流畅流动。让关键帧停留。这是关键到动漫美学。

### 3. **使用颜色闪现进行转换**
代替用渐变过渡，尝试快速的颜色闪现或白色闪现。更有冲击力。

### 4. **眼睛在所有情绪中都显示**
一个好的眼睛特写可以传达整个故事。使用多个高光层和虹膜细节。

### 5. **混合静动**
在3秒的快速动作之后留出1-2秒的静止时间。这创造了视觉节奏。

### 6. **使用粒子有意义**
樱花不是偶然的。粒子应该建议环境、情感或超自然元素。

### 7. **背景应该支持，不是主导**
虽然细节很重要，但人物应该始终是焦点。背景应该在焦点外或略微模糊。

### 8. **音频是关键**
沉默的时刻与激烈的音乐一样强大。许多动漫序列都有战略性的沉默。

---

## 快速参考：Seedance 2.0（Higgsfield）动漫最佳实践

1. **优先考虑眼睛**：好的眼睛特写可以开始或结束任何序列
2. **有限动画是特征**：不要试图让一切都平滑。使用暂停。
3. **色彩设置心情**：选择配合您想要的情感的调色板
4. **速度线表示运动**：在大动作时期添加透视线
5. **影响帧有效**：在戏剧性时刻冻结0.2-0.5秒
6. **背景无需逼真**：动漫背景通常被简化和风格化
7. **粒子添加意义**：樱花、火花或能量应该与故事相关
8. **音频完成整体体验**：音乐和音效都很重要

## 常见问题

**Q：我能让Seedance 2.0在Higgsfield上创建完整的动漫开场吗？**
A：是的，但分开做。开场通常是60-90秒。将其分成3个30秒的片段，然后在编辑中连接。

**Q：Seedance 2.0在Higgsfield能处理快速的闪电穿过吗？**
A：是的。使用快速的白色闪现和电蓝色的痕迹。对运动模糊和帧冻结的细节要求很高。

**Q：我应该在Seedance 2.0上为动漫中的文本气泡做什么？**
A：将其指定为叠加。Seedance 2.0可以生成清晰的文本叠加。或在最后添加它在编辑中。

**Q：我如何为变身序列创建闪光？**
A：指定一个1-2秒的白色闪现，然后快速切割到变身形式。Flash应该极其明亮。

**Q：Seedance 2.0上的粒子有多详细？**
A：粒子非常详细。速度线可以精确控制。樱花可以有光线通过它们。指定您想要的东西。

records.readme_markdown:
# firecrawl download

> **Experimental.** Convenience command that combines `map` + `scrape` to save an entire site as local files.

Maps the site first to discover pages, then scrapes each one into nested directories under `.firecrawl/`. All scrape options work with download. Always pass `-y` to skip the confirmation prompt.

## When to use

- You want to save an entire site (or section) to local files
- You need offline access to documentation or content
- Bulk content extraction with organized file structure

## Quick start

```bash
# Interactive wizard (picks format, screenshots, paths for you)
firecrawl download https://docs.example.com

# With screenshots
firecrawl download https://docs.example.com --screenshot --limit 20 -y

# Multiple formats (each saved as its own file per page)
firecrawl download https://docs.example.com --format markdown,links --screenshot --limit 20 -y
# Creates per page: index.md + links.txt + screenshot.png

# Filter to specific sections
firecrawl download https://docs.example.com --include-paths "/features,/sdks"

# Skip translations
firecrawl download https://docs.example.com --exclude-paths "/zh,/ja,/fr,/es,/pt-BR"

# Full combo
firecrawl download https://docs.example.com \
  --include-paths "/features,/sdks" \
  --exclude-paths "/zh,/ja" \
  --only-main-content \
  --screenshot \
  -y
```

## Download options

| Option                    | Description                                              |
| ------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--limit <n>`             | Max pages to download                                    |
| `--search <query>`        | Filter URLs by search query                              |
| `--include-paths <paths>` | Only download matching paths                             |
| `--exclude-paths <paths>` | Skip matching paths                                      |
| `--allow-subdomains`      | Include subdomain pages                                  |
| `-y`                      | Skip confirmation prompt (always use in automated flows) |

## Scrape options (all work with download)

`-f <formats>`, `-H`, `-S`, `--screenshot`, `--full-page-screenshot`, `--only-main-content`, `--include-tags`, `--exclude-tags`, `--wait-for`, `--max-age`, `--country`, `--languages`

## See also

- [firecrawl-map](../firecrawl-map/SKILL.md) — just discover URLs without downloading
- [firecrawl-scrape](../firecrawl-scrape/SKILL.md) — scrape individual pages
- [firecrawl-crawl](../firecrawl-crawl/SKILL.md) — bulk extract as JSON (not local files)
